title: Account Director, Startups | New Business - UK&I
description:
About the Team

OpenAI’s mission is to build safe artificial general intelligence (AGI) which benefits all of humanity. This long-term undertaking brings the world’s best scientists, engineers, and business professionals into one lab together to accomplish this.

In pursuit of this mission, our Go To Market (GTM) team is responsible for helping customers learn how to leverage and deploy our highly capable AI products across their business. The team is made of Sales, Solutions, Support, Marketing, and Partnership professionals that work together to create valuable solutions that will help bring AI to as many users as possible.

About the Role

OpenAI is seeking a highly motivated and experienced Account Director to join our Startups UKI Go To Market team. You will play a critical role in owning relationships with top startup customers and supporting them in building successfully on the OpenAI platform.

We believe that many of the most disruptive and category-defining AI applications will be created by startups. The Startup Go To Market team’s mission is to help startups harness the power of AI models to drive these advances. You will support startups building effectively with OpenAI’s APIs, and provide access to OpenAI teams and expertise to support their growth.

This role is a mixture of technical understanding, vision, partnership, and strategy. You’ll be responsible for serving as the primary relationship owner for a set of strategically important startup customers, as well as working across the OpenAI organization to help these startups accelerate their progress and be successful using our models. You’ll work cross-functionality with product, research, engineering, support, and solutions architecture to help customers get the most out of our models.

This role is based in London. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week.

In this role, you will:

 - Manage a portfolio of startups accounts, developing and executing strategies for a comprehensive account plan.

 - Partner with solutions and research engineering to build and execute complex customer programs and projects.

 - Own a consumption revenue target.

 - Manage consumption revenue forecasts.

 - Analyze key account metrics to create reports and provide insights to internal and external stakeholders.

 - Closely monitor the industry landscape (people, competitors, partners, etc.) to contribute to product roadmap and other corporate strategies.

 - Collaborate with solutions, marketing, communications, business operations, people operations, finance, product management, and engineering.

 - Serve as an advocate for improving the startup experience building with OpenAI, synthesizing product feedback from insights captured from our work with startups.

 - Closely monitor the industry landscape and startup landscape to contribute to product roadmap and other corporate strategies.

 - Support the recruitment and onboarding of other teammates.

 - Support the development of company culture.

We're seeking someone with experience in:

 - 6+ years selling platform-as-a-service and/or software-as-a-service.

 - Designing and executing complex deal strategies.

 - Experience working in or around the startup ecosystem, preferably as either a founder of a startup, an employee of a startup, or someone who worked with startup customers.

 - Supporting the growth of fast-growing, high-performance companies.

 - Working directly with C-level executives.

 - Communicating technical concepts to customers and internal stakeholders.

 - Leading high-visibility customer events (CAB, conferences, product launches, etc.).

 - Gathering, distilling, and processing complex market (industry, competitor, customer, prospect) intelligence.

You might thrive in this role if you:

 - Are customer-centric. You are motivated to deeply understand your customer’s priorities and help them achieve their vision for using our models to improve their products and services. You build strong relationships with executives and professionals across functions and serve as a trusted advisor.

 - Have a passion or deep curiosity in artificial intelligence. You embrace the opportunity to help deploy our technology in a way that benefits humanity. You’re excited to educate our customers on AI and how to plan for the future.

 - Are a builder. You are excited to impact how our company operates and scales. Your passion is building strong systems and processes from the ground up and executing them with precision.

 - Are excited by new challenges. You don’t have the answers to every question up front, but the process of solving them invigorates you. Bespoke issues requiring multidimensional knowledge excite you. You’re willing to experiment with new solutions.

 - Are a strategist. You deeply understand go to market best practices and raise the bar for our organization. You think and plan forward on the order of years and bring internal and external stakeholders along with your strategy.



About OpenAI

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. 

We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. 

For additional information, please see OpenAI’s Affirmative Action and Equal Employment Opportunity Policy Statement https://cdn.openai.com/policies/eeo-policy-statement.pdf.

title: Technical Governance Risk & Compliance Specialist
description:
Ebury helps ambitious businesses unlock global growth, and we take the same approach with our people. We encourage innovation and movement, collaboration and problem-solving, and foster an environment where everyone can feel they belong, are valued, supported and empowered to succeed.
 If you’re a collaborator who wants to help transform how businesses operate globally, get in touch - we’d love to discuss how Ebury can accelerate your career so you can shape the future.
 Technology GRC Lead
• 
 Location: London - Hybrid - 4 days on site 1 day remote 
 Role Overview
 Technology is accountable to Internal Audit, Compliance, and Risk for how it manages technology risk and meets its regulatory obligations. This role directly owns that accountability.
 You will lead the Technology GRC programme, maintaining Tech’s overall compliance posture, providing a centralised view of risks, controls, and audit findings, and integrating GRC priorities directly into the core Technology roadmap.
 Reporting to the Head of Security Engineering, you will serve as the primary liaison between Technology and internal/external oversight bodies (Internal Audit, Compliance, IT Risk), representing the department at executive risk committees.
 Key Responsibilities
 Technology GRC Programme Management
• 
 Own the Programme: Drive Technology’s compliance posture and establish a single source of truth for technology risk and compliance metrics.
• 
 Centralise Requests: Manage and triage incoming audit, risk, and compliance inquiries across Technology and Engineering, setting coordinated response strategies and holding stakeholders accountable.
• 
 Maintain Risk Registers: Administer the Technology risk register in AuditBoard, ensuring risk ratings, control mappings, and action plans are actively maintained and agreed upon by risk owners.
• 
 Governance & Reporting: Represent Technology at risk committees, delivering data-driven reporting on KPIs, risk positions, and remediation progress.
 Audit, Assurance & Control Frameworks
• 
 Audit Execution: Lead internal and external audits end-to-end—from initial scoping and evidence coordination to remediation and closure.
• 
 Remediation Tracking: Enforce agreed remediation timelines across engineering teams, escalating proactively to senior leadership when target dates slip.
• 
 Control Design: Align and define the Technology control framework against industry standards (ISO 27001, NIST, CIS) and applicable regulatory mandates.
• 
 Policy Governance: Author, update, and manage the approval lifecycle for Technology policies, standards, and standard operating procedures (SOPs).
 Engineering Integration & Automation
• 
 Roadmap Alignment: Translate findings, risks, and regulatory deadlines into concrete deliverables within the Technology product and engineering backlogs.
• 
 Resource Allocation: Partner with Technology Directors during planning cycles to ensure compliance tasks are prioritised alongside feature work.
• 
 Compliance as Code: Collaborate with engineering teams to implement automated control validation and continuous evidence collection, minimising manual compliance overhead.
 Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM)
• 
 Vendor Assessments: Lead security and risk evaluations for technology vendors, software providers, and SaaS tools.
• 
 Contractual Standards: Define mandatory security clauses and compliance requirements during vendor onboarding and contract negotiations.
 What You’ll Bring
 Required Experience & Qualifications
• 
 Experience: 3+ years in IT/Cybersecurity GRC, IT Risk, or IT Audit—ideally within a regulated environment (such as financial services or fintech).
• 
 End-to-End Ownership: Proven track record of independently leading technology audits and risk programmes, rather than solely performing administrative support.
• 
 Framework Fluency: Practical working knowledge of ISO 27001, NIST, and CIS, along with a firm grasp of IT General Controls (ITGCs) across access management, change management, and IT operations.
• 
 Technical Credibility: Solid technical grounding in cloud environments (AWS/GCP/Azure), IAM, CI/CD pipelines, and secure SDLC to evaluate risk and challenge technical assertions objectively.
• 
 Executive Presence: Proven ability to present complex risk metrics, dashboards, and positions to risk committees and senior executives.
• 
 Stakeholder Management: High diplomatic assertiveness—comfortable holding senior stakeholders to remediation dates and escalating objectively when required.
• 
 Communication: Exceptional written and verbal communication in English, with the ability to bridge conversations between software engineers and non-technical auditors.
 Desired Experience & Qualifications
• 
 Hands-on experience administering modern GRC platforms (e.g., AuditBoard).
• 
 Familiarity with regulations and frameworks such as DORA, PCI DSS, or SOC 2 (Type II).
• 
 Experience implementing automated compliance monitoring or evidence pipelines.
• 
 Relevant industry certifications (e.g., CISA, CRISC, CISM, or ISO 27001 Lead Auditor).
 About us 
 Ebury delivers sophisticated, integrated solutions — business accounts, hedging, and financing — on a single platform with a seamless workflow. Our success is built on a simple premise and singular purpose: To help businesses operate and scale globally.

title: Strategy Analyst
description:
ABOUT LENDABLE

Lendable is on a mission to build the world's best technology to help people get credit and save money. We're building one of the world’s leading fintech companies and are off to a strong start:



 - One of the UK’s most exciting unicorns with a team of over 800 people

 - Among the fastest-growing tech companies in the UK

 - Profitable since 2017

 - Backed by top investors including Balderton Capital and Goldman Sachs

 - Loved by customers with the best reviews in the market (4.9 across 10,000s of reviews on Trustpilot https://uk.trustpilot.com/review/lendable.co.uk)



So far, we’ve rebuilt the Big Three consumer finance products from scratch: loans, credit cards and car finance. We get money into our customers’ hands in minutes instead of days.



We’re growing fast, and there’s a lot more to do: we’re going after the two biggest Western markets (UK and US) where trillions worth of financial products are held by big banks with dated systems and painful processes.




JOIN US IF YOU WANT TO

 1. Take ownership: you are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Lendable from day 1

 2. Work in small teams of exceptional people: Lendies are relentlessly resourceful. We challenge the status quo to solve problems and find smarter solutions

 3. Build the best technology in-house: we use new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting



We’re looking for an analytical, commercially-minded  Strategy Analyst to help us grow and scale the product exponentially. This is a dynamic role where you’ll tackle high impact business problems across a number of disciplines including pricing, growth, credit risk, new product development and product analytics.

You’ll help us solve our most complex multi-dimensional challenges, working cross-functionally to deliver insight-driven strategies that optimise performance, drive responsible growth, and put the customer at the heart of decision-making.

You’ll operate in a fast-paced environment where ideas matter more than hierarchy, and execution beats bureaucracy. Your work will directly influence who we serve, how we grow, and how we deliver sustainable value.

 
 

Key Responsibilities

Drive pricing & promotions optimisation:

 - Support the development and optimisation of pricing and promotional strategies across our channels and products through data-driven analysis, balancing customer engagement, growth, price elasticity and profitability, while continuously refining approaches based on product performance and scenario modelling

 - Analyse performance at channel, product and customer segment level to identify opportunities to improve pricing, product and conversion efficiency

 - Build insight into conversion funnel performance and highlight where cost or conversion can be improved

 - Stay abreast of industry trends and market activity to ensure our products remain competitive and fit for purpose

Pricing experimentation & impact assessment:

 - Design, set up and run pricing tests and product A/B and multivariate experiments, working with Product, Data Science and Engineering to ensure they are implemented correctly

 - Track experiment performance against pre-agreed success metrics and guardrails, and deliver clear readouts with recommendations on whether to roll out, iterate or stop

 - Measure the realised impact of commercial initiatives after launch, and compare outcomes against the original business case

 - Build and maintain monitoring of key commercial metrics so the team can track the impact of changes over time

 - Build a growing evidence base on price elasticity from these tests to inform future pricing decisions

 - Validate that implemented pricing and strategy changes are working as intended once deployed in production, flagging and investigating any unexpected behaviour.

Evaluate expansion opportunities:

 - Support the evaluation of new product, channel and segment opportunities by extracting and analysing data and contributing to commercial models

 - Help maintain assessment frameworks and tooling so that evaluations are consistent and repeatable

Collaboration & communication:

 - Collaborate with stakeholders across Credit Risk, Data Science, Product and Growth to bring your strategies to life.

 - Present analysis and recommendations clearly and concisely, backed by data, to the team and wider stakeholders.

 - Document analyses, queries and experiment results so they are reusable by the wider team.

Your experience

   - Can be a placement year within a University Course. 

 - Proficiency in SQL; working knowledge of Python.

 - Hands-on exposure to A/B and multivariate testing. 

 - A structured approach to problem solving and strong attention to detail

 - Comfort working through ambiguity and working on problems and projects end to end with support.

Desirable:

title: Reporting & Data Analyst (6-Month FTC)
description:
THE ROLE 📝 
 We’re looking for a Reporting & Data Analyst to help Form3 develop a more reliable, scalable and accessible reporting capability across the organisation. 
 This is a six-month fixed-term contract with two clear priorities: completing and enhancing the Customer Service reporting suite in AWS QuickSight, and building trusted, reusable datasets that enable teams to create and maintain their own reporting. 
 You’ll work across the business to improve data quality, reduce manual reporting and establish stronger documentation, governance and knowledge transfer for the future. 
• Complete and enhance the Customer Service reporting suite and reporting deck in AWS QuickSight. 
• Design, build and document reusable datasets for multiple reporting use cases. 
• Integrate key business systems into curated reporting datasets. 
• Translate stakeholder questions into clear data and dashboard requirements. 
• Establish consistent business metrics, definitions and reporting logic. 
• Automate manual reporting and duplicated data preparation where possible. 
• Validate reporting outputs and investigate data-quality issues. 
• Provide knowledge transfer to internal teams and support a longer-term reporting roadmap. 
 WE’RE LOOKING FOR 🔍 
 Essential 
• Experience in a Reporting Analyst, Data Analyst, BI Analyst or similar role. 
• Hands-on experience building and maintaining dashboards using AWS QuickSight or a comparable BI platform. 
• Practical experience using SQL and Python for reporting, data transformation or analysis. 
• Experience working with multiple data sources and translating stakeholder requirements into accurate, maintainable reporting. 
• A self-sufficient and pragmatic approach, with the ability to take ownership and deliver within a focused six-month engagement. 
 Desirable 
• Experience using Amazon Athena or a similar cloud-based data querying service. 
• Experience creating curated datasets for self-service reporting. 
• Experience improving data quality, reporting governance and technical documentation. 
• Experience working in a start-up, scale-up or small team where you have had broad ownership. 
 TECH STACK ⚙️ 
• AWS QuickSight - building dashboards, reporting suites and reusable datasets. 
• SQL - querying, transforming and validating reporting data. 
• Python - supporting data transformation, automation and reporting workflows. 
• Business and operational systems - integrating data sources into trusted reporting datasets. 
 INTERVIEW PROCESS ✍️ 
 Stage 1: Screening Call with Talent Team 
 Stage 2: Practical Technical Task 
 Stage 3: Interview with the Hiring Manager, including a discussion of your technical task and your approach to reporting, data quality, stakeholder requirements and self-service analytics 
 We always aim to stick to the above process, however there may be occasions when an additional interview stage is needed for us to be sure we’re hiring the right fit for the role. 
 HIRING LOCATIONS📍 
 Here are the locations that we are hiring from for this position. 
• United Kingdom 
 All new joiners start their first day in our office to collect the equipment needed to work remotely. We'll also arrange for some of your team to come in to say hi, ensuring you're supported and have a positive first few days with Form3! 
 BENEFITS 🏝️ 
 Form3 are a 100% remote, flexible business and are able to offer part-time working arrangements. We believe this enables our people to achieve amazing things with a healthy work-life balance. 
 For further information on what it’s like to work here, and for more information on our full benefits package, visit our careers page . If you have any other questions, we’d be happy to discuss these with your during the interview process. 
 ABOUT FORM3 💭 
 Revolutionising the world of payments with our cloud-native, multi-cloud platform. For more information about Form3, check out the following pages: 
 What we do | Life at Form3 | Benefits | P ayments Cannot Fail Series | .Tech Podcast 
 OUR DEI&B COMMITMENT 
 We hire talented people from a variety of backgrounds and experiences and are committed to a work environment based on diversity, open-mindedness and curiosity. We’re united by our company values (we even created them together!) and we celebrate our unique differences. 
 Our employee lifecycle processes are designed to embrace equal opportunity and prevent discrimination against our people regardless of personal characteristics. It is our strong belief that the more inclusive and belonging we are as a business, the better our work will be. 
 As an inclusive employer, we guarantee to interview all neurodiverse and physically disabled applicants who meet the minimum criteria for this role. We also encourage candidates to notify us of any reasonable adjustments that may be required during the recruitment process. This includes providing job adverts in alternative, accessible formats or adjustments required at interview stage. 
 If you consider yourself to be neurodiverse or physically disabled under the UN definition of disability and would like to be considered under this scheme and/or require any reasonable adjustments please let us know by sending an email to careers@form3.tech clearly stating your consent for us to process this data. 
 For more information please refer to our Recruitment Data Policy .

description:
Ebury helps ambitious businesses unlock global growth, and we take the same approach with our people. We encourage innovation and movement, collaboration and problem-solving, and foster an environment where everyone can feel they belong, are valued, supported and empowered to succeed.
 If you’re a collaborator who wants to help transform how businesses operate globally, get in touch - we’d love to discuss how Ebury can accelerate your career so you can shape the future.
 Enterprise Sales Lead – AI Financial Crime Platform 
 Ebury London - Office based 
 *Fincrime AI team within Ebury - You will be the first dedicated commercial hire* 
 About the Role 
 We have built an AI-powered financial crime investigation platform. Its AI agents review screening alerts and cases the way an experienced analyst would, with the evidence, the reasoning and a full audit trail, and with humans kept in control. It is live in production at Ebury, working through thousands of cases and reducing analyst workload while maintaining regulatory standards.
 We are now taking it to other regulated firms, and we are looking for the first dedicated enterprise sales hire to lead that work. You will own the commercial motion from first conversation to signed contract: building pipeline, running discovery with senior compliance and operations leaders, designing proofs of concept that convert, and telling us what the market needs.
 This is an early commercial journey. There is no established playbook and no inbound flow to rely on, and the commercial structure around the product is still being shaped. That is the opportunity: you will write the playbook, and your first customers will shape the product.
 What You’ll Do 
• Build and own a pipeline of regulated firms across the UK and Europe, including banks, payments firms and fintechs, from target list through to first contracts
• Lead discovery with Heads of Financial Crime, MLROs, COOs and Chief Compliance Officers, and turn what the AI can do into their business case: cost per alert, backlogs, quality and regulatory expectations
• Run the full enterprise sales cycle, including security review, procurement, model risk governance and legal, working closely with engineering and compliance experts
• Design proofs of concept with clear success criteria that lead to paid contracts
• Help shape pricing and packaging, including usage-based models
• Build relationships with advisers, consultancies, industry bodies and technology partners who influence buying decisions
• Bring structured market feedback to Product and Engineering: what buyers ask, where they hesitate, what blocks a deal
• Lay the foundations for a sales function: pipeline discipline, honest forecasting, sales materials and case studies, and a view on the next hires
 What We’re Looking For 
 Must Have 
• Substantial experience selling complex solutions to banks, payments firms or other regulated financial institutions. This could be software, technology-enabled services or consulting
• Working knowledge of financial crime compliance (AML, sanctions screening, transaction monitoring, KYC), enough to hold a credible conversation with a Head of Fincrime Operations
• A track record of owning a long, multi-stakeholder enterprise sale involving compliance, operations, technology, security, procurement and legal
• Self-starter energy: you build your own pipeline and do not depend on a famous brand or a flow of inbound leads
• Strong commercial judgement: you can build a business case, negotiate, and forecast honestly
• Clear, credible communication with senior stakeholders, in conversation and in writing
 Nice to Have 
• Experience selling regtech, financial crime or AI products
• Background in a financial crime or regulatory practice at a consultancy or advisory firm
• Hands-on experience in compliance, MLRO or financial crime operations roles
• Experience selling AI in regulated environments: model risk management, explainability, auditability, data residency
• Early-stage experience, such as being one of the first sales hires
• An existing network across UK and European financial institutions and their advisers
 What Sets Senior Apart 
• Commercial ownership: you take responsibility for the number and for the path to it, not only the activity
• Buyer empathy: you understand how a compliance leader’s year, budget and regulator conversations actually work
• Straight talk: you do not oversell AI, you forecast honestly, and you say early when a deal is not real
• Structured learning: you capture what every conversation teaches us and turn it into decisions
• Pragmatism: you balance ideal process with the speed an early-stage motion needs
• Builder mindset: you are comfortable creating the process, not only following one
 Why Join Us? 
• A real product in production: the platform is already doing the work at Ebury, so you are selling something proven, not a roadmap
• First commercial hire: your decisions on market, pricing and process will have lasting impact
• Direct access to leadership and to the engineers who build the product
• Cutting-edge AI in a high-stakes domain, at a time when regulated firms are actively looking for answers
• Startup speed with enterprise backing: a small, autonomous team supported by Ebury’s resources and credibility
• Competitive package: salary, performance-linked variable pay, benefits and flexible working
 The Team

 If you’re a collaborator who wants to help transform how businesses operate globally, get in touch - we’d love to discuss how Ebury can accelerate your career so you can shape the future.
 Commercial Analyst 
 London Victoria – 4 days in the office, 1 day work from home 
 As a Commercial Analyst at Ebury London, you will play a critical role in driving efficiency and performance across the revenue-generating functions of the business. You'll partner closely with Sales, Marketing, and Data leadership, using data and analytics to optimise processes, improve forecasting accuracy, and support strategic decision-making. We're looking for a candidate with a few years of experience in a similar analytics or revenue operations role, who is confident working with data and translating it into clear, actionable recommendations for senior stakeholders.
 Key Responsibilities 
• Revenue Analytics: Collect, analyse, and interpret data across the revenue funnel to identify trends, risks, and opportunities. Build and maintain KPIs and dashboards that give leadership real-time visibility into pipeline health, conversion rates, and revenue performance.
• Process Optimisation: Assess end-to-end revenue processes — from lead generation through to renewal — and identify bottlenecks or inefficiencies. Design and implement improvements to pipeline management, forecasting, and reporting workflows.
• Forecasting & Reporting: Own regular reporting on revenue performance, pipeline metrics, and forecasts. Partner with Finance and Sales leadership to improve forecast accuracy and provide insights on growth opportunities, segmentation, and cross-sell/up-sell potential.

title: Senior Data Analyst (Fraud & Financial Crime)
description:
Our Story
 
Hello there. We’re Zopa.
 
We started our journey back in 2005, building the first ever peer-to-peer lending company. Fast forward to 2020 and we launched Zopa Bank. A bank that listens to what our customers don’t like about finance and does the opposite. We’re redefining what it feels like to work in finance. Our vision for a new era of banking puts people front and centre — we’ve built a business that empowers everyone to aim high, every day, to move finance forward. Find out more about our fantastic offerings at Zopa.com! 
 
We’re incredibly proud of our achievements and none of it would be possible without the amazing team here. It’s not just industry awards we’re winning, we’ve also been named in the top three UK’s Most Loved Workplaces. 
 
If you embrace unconventional challenges, are unafraid to think differently and are driven to make an outsized impact, you’ll thrive here at Zopa, so join us, and make it count. Want to see us in action? Follow us on Instagram @zopalife


We’re looking for a Senior Data Analyst to join our Fraud & Financial Crime Analytics team at Zopa. 
You’ll useyour analytical skills and hands-on SQL experienceto help protect our customers and the bank from fraud and financial crime, while making sure genuine customers experience as little friction as possible. Your initial focus will be on card transactions and related events, including card tokens and account takeover. 
This is a hands-on role where you’ll own the analysis, implementation and ongoing performance of our controls. You’ll work with large datasets, identify emerging risks and use your findings to design and improve the rules and models that help keep our customers safe. 
You don’t need to have worked in fraud or financial crime before. We’re looking for a strong analyst who enjoys solving complex problems, is curious about how things work and wants to build expertise in this area. 
Why this role matters 
Fraud and financial crime are constantly evolving, and so are the products and services we offer our customers. To grow safely, we need controls that can identify and prevent harm while allowing genuine customers to use their accounts with confidence. 
We want to build the next generation of fraud and financial crime controls, using modern data, technology and AI to stay ahead of emerging threats and make our detection as effective as it can be. 
You’ll be embedded in one of our product squads as part of the wider Fraud & Financial Crime Analytics team, working alongside Fraud Risk, Operations, Data Science, Engineering and Product. Together, you’ll help shape, build and continuously improve the controls that protect our customers. 
This is one of the most impactful analytics roles in the business. In the same day, you could be triaging a new fraud risk, designing the controls to stop it and protecting our customers from harm. 
This is an opportunity to bring your own ideas, shape how we solve problems and make a visible impact on both our customers and the business. 

• 
 Own and improve controls: Analyse, implement, test and optimise rules and other controls that prevent and detect fraud and financial crime. 
• 
 Investigate emerging risks: Use data to identify suspicious patterns, understand changing threats and recommend practical ways to respond. 
• 
 Measure what matters: Monitor detection, losses, false positives and alert volumes to understand control performance and identify opportunities to improve. 
• 
 Test and learn: Develop hypotheses and evaluate new approaches, balancing improvements in detection with the impact on genuine customers and Operations. 
• 
 Build the next generation of controls: Work with Data Science, Product and Engineering to explore how new data, models, AI and automation can improve our detection and how we work. 
• 
 Support change: Help implement and monitor model-led controls, and test and migrate controls as our platforms evolve. 
• 
 Shape your priorities: Work with the squad to identify and prioritise opportunities, influence decisions and share your knowledge with others.
• 
 Strong analytical experience and advanced SQL skills, including the ability to work confidently with large, complex datasets. 
• 
 Experience using Python for analysis, or the ability and willingness to develop those skills. 
• 
 A track record of owning complex analytical problems from initial question through to a clear recommendation or implemented change. 
• 
 The ability to take an open-ended problem, work out where to start and turn it into a clear analytical approach. 
• 
 Experience using data to assess performance, identify opportunities and make decisions. 
• 
 An understanding of basic machine learning concepts and performance metrics, such as precision and recall, or exposure to using them to assess controls. 
• 
 Sound judgement and the ability to balance analytical rigour with the need to make timely decisions. 
• 
 The ability to tell a clear story with data and use your insights to influence technical and non-technical stakeholders. 
• 
 A collaborative approach and confidence working with people across different teams and levels of seniority. 
• 
 Curiosity about new tools and an interest in using AI and automation to improve how you work and the controls you build. 
 It would be great if you also have: 
• 
 Experience in fraud, financial crime, risk analytics or another controls-focused environment. 
• 
 Experience analysing card transactions, payments or customer behaviour. 
• 
 Stronger experience working with machine learning models, including evaluating, implementing or monitoring their performance. 
• 
 Experience using AI tools such as Claude to support analysis, coding or automation. 
• 
 Exposure to decisioning systems, rule-based controls or experimentation. 
• 
 Experience with data visualisation tools such as Tableau. 
• 
 Experience in financial services, fintech or another fast-moving, product-led environment.

title: Senior FX Product Manager - Hedging Conversion
description:
Ebury helps ambitious businesses unlock global growth, and we take the same approach with our people. We encourage innovation and movement, collaboration and problem-solving, and foster an environment where everyone can feel they belong, are valued, supported and empowered to succeed.
 If you’re a collaborator who wants to help transform how businesses operate globally, get in touch - we’d love to discuss how Ebury can accelerate your career so you can shape the future.
 FX Senior Product Manager - Hedging conversion 
 Ebury London Office - Hybrid: 4 days in the office, 1 day working from home per week 
 As Ebury scales globally, we are evolving from a delivery-led organisation into a platform-led product company - building shared foundations that allow teams to move faster, operate safely in regulated environments and deliver high-quality client experiences across channel
 The Opportunity 
 We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to own one number: the share of Ebury's clients who convert into hedgers — and to build the journeys, workflows and decision tools that get them there.
 Ebury has a real hedging business. Thousands of clients already hedge with us, they're our most valuable and stickiest, and Hedge works. The problem isn't proof of concept — it's rate. For every client who converts, several more carry the same currency exposure, would benefit from the same forward, and never get there.
 Here's the honest reason why. Hedging isn't a product you sell; it's a conclusion a client reaches once they can see what their international business is actually exposed to. Today that seeing happens in a CPM's head and a spreadsheet, one client at a time. The client can't see their own exposure clearly, the CPM can't see it at scale, and so the conversation that should be obvious either happens late or never happens at all.
 This role builds the layer that changes that: guided journeys and lifecycle workflows that carry a client from unaware exposure to a first hedge to a standing policy — and the decision tools that let both the client and their CPM understand the client's international business well enough to make the right call, not just the next call.
 You'll sit at the intersection of product, data, and commercial, working closely with:
• CPMs and Sales teams who convert clients today
• Data and Analytics
• Design and Engineering
• Compliance and Risk
• Clients directly
 What you’ll do 
 You will own the end-to-end conversion journey into hedging, backed by a dedicated squad of developers, including:
 Journeys & Lifecycle Workflows 
• The path from spot client → Hedge-active → policy client, and every drop-off point along it
• Guided, staged journeys rather than one-off prompts: the right message, to the right client, at the moment their exposure is real to them
• Triggered workflows off real events, a new currency pair, a large invoice, a rate move against them, a forward maturing
• Understanding what separates the clients who convert from the ones who don't, and building for the difference
 Decision Tools for Clients 
• Showing a client what their international business is actually exposed to, in their own numbers and their own currencies
• Exposure views, scenario and impact modelling, MTM and forward comparisons a finance lead can act on without training
• Turning "should I hedge?" into a question the client can answer for themselves, with confidence
• Balancing honesty about risk against simplicity of decision, the goal is a well-made decision, not a sold one
 Tooling for CPMs 
• Giving CPMs a portfolio-level view of client exposure, trades and performance, so they know who to talk to and what to say before the client asks
• Surfacing the signals that make a conversation timely: unhedged exposure, changing trade patterns, policy lapses
• Learning from the conversations that already convert clients, and productising them
 Repeat Hedging & Policy 
• Turning a first hedge into a second and a third
• Moving clients from ad-hoc trades onto a standing hedging policy they run every month
• Statements, notifications and review moments that build the habit and prove the value after the fact
 Experimentation & Measurement 
• A cadence of A/B tests across the journey, not a feature backlog
• Reading results honestly, including the ones that kill your own ideas
• Building the measurement so conversion, and what's driving it
 What success looks like (12-18 months) 
• Spot-to-hedger conversion rate is measurably higher, and you can attribute the lift
• A meaningful share of new hedgers convert through product journeys rather than a CPM conversation
• CPMs work from exposure signals in a tool instead of instinct and spreadsheets, and cover more clients as a result
• Clients can articulate their own FX exposure — and clients who hedge once come back without being called
• More hedgers move onto hedging policies rather than trading ad hoc
• Product — not people — becomes the primary driver of hedging conversion
 What makes this role hard 
• You're changing behaviour, not shipping features. The instrument already exists and works; the reason more clients don't use it is understanding, trust and habit.
• It's a two-sided problem. Clients and CPMs need different views of the same truth, and building for one badly makes the other worse but the CPMs must know what the client can see to have consultative conversations
• The baseline isn't zero. There's an existing business and an existing way of converting clients, you have to improve on it without disrupting it.
• Exposure is genuinely hard to model. Client data is incomplete, trade history is a proxy for intent, and being confidently wrong about someone's exposure destroys trust instantly.
• You're helping non-experts make decisions with real financial consequences. Oversimplify and you mislead; don't simplify and nobody acts.
• You'll navigate real-world complexity: regional and regulatory nuance, credit and margin implications, and client segments w

description:
Every team has AI. Few have mastered it. Humans were built to adapt, but AI is now moving faster than most workforces can.

Multiverse is the AI adoption layer: the missing link between the AI tools that companies have invested in and the people expected to use them.

Our ambition is to put AI capability in every worker’s hands. Apprenticeships got us started: we’ve trained over a third of the UK’s data and AI apprentices, worked with a third of the FTSE 100, and generated £2bn+ in verified ROI. Now Mastry, our new adaptive learning platform, takes that further, guiding a company’s AI workforce transformation from start to finish. Mae, our AI guide inside Mastry, is a real-time AI agent that thinks, speaks, listens and sees, working alongside the tools you already use, like Claude and Copilot.

We closed our latest fundraising round in April 2026, with $500m+ raised in total from VC partners including Index Ventures, General Catalyst, Schroders Capital and Lightspeed. With a $2.1bn valuation, we are Europe’s first EdTech double unicorn, and we are just getting started.

If you want to shape how the workforce wins in the AI era, come and join us.


THE OPPORTUNITY

We are at an inflection point in our journey. Our platform now serves tens of thousands of learners, demand for AI skills is accelerating, and we are investing seriously in the product and technology that will take us to the next stage of scale. This is a role for someone who wants to build the product that gets more people into transformative learning, and upskill people with critical data and AI skills faster.




THE ROLE

We are looking for a Lead Product Manager to own Prescribe: the product that helps a prospective learner find the right programme for their skills and their employer's goals, then takes them to a confident commitment and a successful start. You will be the strategic counterpart to a Senior Engineering Manager, working alongside design and data, and closely with our go-to-market and fulfilment teams.

Growth at Multiverse means getting more people from first interest to a confident start, and it is a product problem, not a marketing problem. You will own the conversion metrics, set the strategy, run the experiments, and drive the outcomes. AI will drive much of the improvement, and you will decide where it helps.

AI-native product experiences

 - Shape new conversational, AI-first experiences that help learners and customers understand the best programme for their skills and career development.

 - Turn learner and customer behaviour into product direction.

Prescription and eligibility

 - Make every recommendation something a learner and a customer can understand and challenge.

Recommendation, commitment and finalisation

Metrics and experimentation

You will identify and manage relationships with strategic product partners in Germany and on cross-border opportunities, ranging from global technology platforms to regional champions, including enterprise software vendors, telcos, cloud providers, and government-aligned organizations. This is a deeply cross-functional role requiring close collaboration with Product, Engineering, GTM, Legal, and Policy teams. Although the role has clear accountability for Germany, team priorities may evolve, so you must be ready to take on other markets, verticals, or partnership types.



Please note that this role is based out of our Munich office, with 3 days a week required in the office.



In this role, you will:

 - Own product partnership strategy and execution for Germany, driving end-to-end partnership sourcing and delivery in the market while contributing to broader EMEA and international priorities.

 - Negotiate and close strategic local and cross-border deals across commercial terms, product scope, data/privacy, brand/marketing, incentives, and expansion paths.

 - Over time, lead senior partner relationships: build trust, align on joint value props, and manage complexity.

 - Partner closely with Product, Engineering, GTM, Legal, Policy, and regional counterparts to align roadmaps, navigate constraints, and execute partnership initiatives.

 - Bring deep knowledge of Germany and a strong point of view on country and sub-region differences across EMEA, informing prioritization, positioning, and partner selection. Apply that judgment flexibly when supporting opportunities beyond Germany or in new verticals.

 - Define success metrics and use analytical judgment to assess progress, surface risks, and communicate outcomes to internal stakeholders.

 - 10+ years of experience in product partnerships or partnership business development within the technology industry.

 - Fluency in English and German.

 - Demonstrated success leading high-impact local and international partnerships involving major technology partners, including complex cross-border work.

 - Deep understanding of the German market, combined with experience operating across multiple countries and international markets.

 - Product-savvy with the ability to engage technical stakeholders credibly and influence product direction and roadmap tradeoffs.

 - Exceptional communication, negotiation, and executive presence.

 - Strong analytical instincts and comfort using data to inform decisions and communicate impact.

 - Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, highly ambiguous environment, operate both independently and collaboratively, and adapt quickly across changing markets, verticals, and partnership types.

About us

At Trainline, our purpose is to empower greener travel choices, connecting people and places. https://www.thetrainline.com/terms/sustainability-faqs Trainline enables millions of travellers to find and book the best value tickets across carriers, fares, and journey options through our highly rated mobile app, website, and B2B partner channels. 

Great journeys start with Trainline 🚄 

We’re Europe’s leading independent rail platform, helping millions of travellers find and book the best-value rail and coach journeys across our app, website and partner channels.

Our job is to make the green travel choice the best choice. By building a better train travel experience, we help more people choose rail - creating a positive impact for customers, our business and the planet.

We’re a team of more than 1,000 Trainliners from over 50 nationalities, working across London, Paris, Barcelona, Milan, Edinburgh and Madrid. Now is a brilliant time to join us and help shape the future of travel.

Introducing Global Distribution at Trainline Partner Solutions (TPS) 👋

We’re looking for an ambitious and commercially minded Account Executive to join our Trainline Partner Solutions team, managing key relationships with Travel Management Companies in the UK and Europe.

This is a client-facing, strategic role that blends relationship management, project management, commercial growth, and product advocacy. You’ll be responsible for nurturing partnerships with major B2B clients, ensuring they achieve success with our technology and that Trainline continues to grow as their trusted digital rail partner.

 

What you will do as an Account Executive at Trainline...🚅

• Provide day-to-day support to an assigned portfolio of Trainline Partner Solutions customers.

• Build and manage successful customer relationships, becoming a trusted advisor for our partners.

• Identify growth opportunities and execute them with the help of the team.

• Get involved in ad-hoc projects and business support as needed.

• Support on development and managing a customer communication plan.

• Negotiation and renewal of existing customer contracts.

 

We'd love to hear from you if you have...🔍

• 1-2 years’ experience in Account Management, Customer Success, or Partnership Management, ideally within rail, business travel technology, or the travel space.

• Fluency in English. Additional languages such as French, Spanish, German and/or Italian is advantageous.

• Ability to build and maintain strong client relationships with enterprise or strategic partners.

• Proven experience in managing multiple client workstreams and priorities

• Strong communication skills – written and verbal.

• Confidence with your ability to find your way in ambiguous situations.

• Passion for the rail industry, business travel, and sustainable mobility.

• Experience using Salesforce in an account management/sales environment.



More information:

Enjoy fantastic perks like private healthcare & dental insurance, a generous work from abroad policy, 2-for-1 share purchase plans, an EV Scheme to further reduce carbon emissions, extra festive time off, and excellent family-friendly benefits. 

We prioritise career growth with clear career paths, transparent pay bands, personal learning budgets, and regular learning days. Jump on board and supercharge your career from day one! 

We're operating a hybrid model and ask that Trainliners work from the office a minimum of 60% of their time over a 12-week period. We also have a 28-day Work from Abroad policy.

Our values represent the things that matter most to us and what we live and breathe everyday, in everything we do: 

 - 💭 Think Big - We're building the future of rail 

 - ✔️ Own It - We focus on every customer, partner and journey 

 - 🤝  Travel Together - We're one team 

 - ♻️ Do Good - We make a positive impact 

We know that having a diverse team makes us better and helps us succeed. And we mean all forms of diversity - gender, ethnicity, sexuality, disability, nationality and diversity of thought. That's why we're committed to creating inclusive places to work, where everyone belongs and differences are valued and celebrated.

title: Associate Product Manager (UK Loans)
description:
ABOUT LENDABLE

Lendable is on a mission to build the world's best technology to help people get credit and save money. We're building one of the world’s leading fintech companies and are off to a strong start:



 - One of the UK’s most exciting unicorns with a team of over 800 people

 - Among the fastest-growing tech companies in the UK

 - Profitable since 2017

 - Backed by top investors including Balderton Capital and Goldman Sachs

 - Loved by customers with the best reviews in the market (4.9 across 10,000s of reviews on Trustpilot https://uk.trustpilot.com/review/lendable.co.uk)



So far, we’ve rebuilt the Big Three consumer finance products from scratch: loans, credit cards and car finance. We get money into our customers’ hands in minutes instead of days.



We’re growing fast, and there’s a lot more to do: we’re going after the two biggest Western markets (UK and US) where trillions worth of financial products are held by big banks with dated systems and painful processes.




JOIN US IF YOU WANT TO

 1. Take ownership: you are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Lendable from day 1

 2. Work in small teams of exceptional people: Lendies are relentlessly resourceful. We challenge the status quo to solve problems and find smarter solutions

 3. Build the best technology in-house: we use new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting




ABOUT THE ROLE

We're looking for a proactive, data-driven Associate Product Manager to join our UK Loans product team. You'll play an important role in shaping the customer experience after they take out a loan: from how we engage with customers and manage payments, to how we support those who experience financial difficulty.

APMs at Lendable take ownership of their product changes, working closely with teams across Engineering, Credit, Finance and Operations to solve problems and take the business to the next level.

You'll have the opportunity to solve complex problems, scale impactful products, and help shape the future of our lending experience. If you're excited by fintech and enjoy turning data and customer insight into great products, we'd love to hear from you.




WHAT YOU’LL WORK ON

 - Improving repayment performance: Running experiments to help more customers pay on time, from choosing repayment dates to how and when we remind people to pay.

 - Personalising customer engagement: Own how we communicate across email, SMS and in-app notifications, testing new messages and improving our tooling.

 - Making loan management easier: Optimising and expanding journeys within the Zable SuperApp, particularly for those who need additional financial support.

 - Using data to drive improvements: Work with Credit and Data Science to identify opportunities and build models to improve payment and servicing outcomes. Build dashboards to track key metrics and measure the impact of what we launch.

 - Testing and learning with customers: Running customer research and testing ideas to understand what people need, how they behave and what works best.

 - Taking products from idea to launch: Working across Engineering, Data Science and Operations to understand the impact of new features, coordinate their rollout and make sure they work for both customers and the business.

 - Increasing impact with AI: Building tools and automations with AI that save time for you, the ops team and the wider business
   
   


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Don't worry if you don't meet every single one of the criteria. We'd love to hear from great candidates who are curious, proactive and excited to learn.

 - Experience: 1–2 years in product, or 2-3 years in strategy, analytics, consulting or similar roles, ideally with experience working closely with product or delivery teams to get things done.

 - Communication: You can clearly explain ideas and requirements to different audiences, from writing specs for engineers to training Operations teams.

 - Curiosity: You ask lots of questions and aren't satisfied until you understand why something is happening.

 - Problem-solving: You enjoy forming hypotheses and finding the quickest way to test them, even if the first version is rough around the edges.

 - Data-driven: You're comfortable working with data and can use SQL or Python to investigate problems and answer your own questions.

 - AI-native: You're already experimenting with AI tools like Claude Code, Cursor or Codex in your work or side projects, and are excited to see how far they can take you.

 - Hands-on: You're happy to roll up your sleeves and pick up the small jobs. In a lean product team, no task is beneath your attention.

 - Adaptable: You enjoy variety and like that no two days look quite the same.

 - Bonus: Experience in lending, payments, fintech or a fast-growing startup.
   
   


AI AT LENDABLE

We want to build the most AI-forward financial services company in the world. PMs here make their own dashboards to answer questions that used to need an analyst, build their own agents and workflows to take care of repetitive work, and ship straightforward changes to production themselves. You don't need to be an expert on day one, but we'll expect you to keep pushing what one person can do.




INTERVIEW PROCESS

 - A quick chat with someone from our Product team to see if the role is a good match

 - A 15 minute cognitive assessment

 - A take home task; a practical product challenge to complete in your own time

 - Task debrief with the product team

 - Final round (in our London office) - typically with the CPO and UK Loans MD, Engineering Manager, Head of Product and hiring manager
   
   


LOCATION

This position is a hybrid role based in London, please note we're unable to provide sponsorship for this position




LIFE AT LENDABLE

 - Winning team: the opportunity to scale up one of the world’s most successful fintech companies

 - Flexible working: flexible approach

title: Senior Coaching & Advice Service Manager - (Remote)
location: Hybrid or Remote within the UK
description:
About Moneybox:

At Moneybox, our mission is to give everyone the means to get more out of life. We’re guided by our belief that wealth isn’t about the money, it’s about the means to more: more freedom, opportunities, possibilities, and peace of mind.

Moneybox is an award-winning wealth management platform, helping nearly two million people build wealth throughout their lives, whether they're saving and investing, buying their first home, or planning for retirement.

And now Moneybox is building the means to help more people in more ways - through personal financial advice. We believe that great advice should be available to everyone, at every stage of life, and that technology can help us deliver it with the care, clarity and accountability people deserve.

We're building a new kind of advice service from the ground up, and the people who join us now will help shape how millions of people plan for their future.

 

The Senior Coaching & Advice Service Manager leads Moneybox's team of Financial Coaches and Advice Coaches — the shared service that gives customers a human relationship alongside our digital capability, whether they're being coached through a non-advised decision or guided through our regulated advice journey.

This is a deliberately shared service. Coaches provide non-advised coaching to customers on behalf of Digital Moneybox Limited, segmented by conversation complexity and qualification level; Advice Coaches support customers through our regulated advice journey, and can flex into coaching activity based on capacity. 

You'll own the team, its competence and quality standards, and how technology — including video calls and AI — supports every customer conversation, before, during and after the call.

You will report directly to the Director of Advice, working closely with the Senior Financial Advisers and the Head of Proposition across the wider Advice leadership team.

What you'll be doing

 - You'll lead and grow the Coaches and Advice Coaches team end-to-end — from day-to-day people leadership and competence, through to the technology and processes that shape the customer experience they deliver.
   
   Team leadership & competence
   
   - Line manage the Coaches and Advice Coaches team, providing day-to-day leadership, coaching and support to a growing group of customer-facing colleagues.
   
   - Build and own the T&C scheme for the Coaches and Advice Coaches team — training standards, sign-off criteria and record-keeping — working in partnership with the Director of Advice, who holds overall T&C oversight, so every Coach and Advice Coach is signed off for the conversations they're qualified to have.
   
   - Design and build out development pathways and onboarding plans as the team scales, giving new joiners a fast, confident ramp and existing team members a clear route to progress.
   
   - Manage performance against KPIs, coaching individuals and the team as a whole to consistently strong outcomes.
   
   - Support team development plans and career conversations, including the natural progression from Financial Coach through Advice Coach towards a Financial Adviser pathway.
   
   Customer outcomes & quality
   
   - Own service quality across both the coaching and advice-service experience — the standards the team is held to, and how consistently they're delivered.
   
   - Ensure the team delivers good customer outcomes consistent with Consumer Duty, across both non-advised coaching and advice-service support.
   
   - Monitor and report against agreed SLAs and customer satisfaction scores (CSAT), identifying trends early and acting on them.
   
   - Feed insight from customer interactions back to the wider Moneybox team — Product, Risk & Compliance, Investment and the Advice leadership team — to drive continuous improvement.
   
   Growing the team

title: Sales Operations Business Partner
description:
ABOUT PLEO

Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’.

The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years.

Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together.

About the role

We’re looking for a Sales Operations Business Partner to sit between our sales leadership and the systems, data, and processes that run the revenue engine. You’ll help the sales team understand where deals stand, where revenue is coming from, and where it’s at risk. You’ll own how we track pipeline, report on performance, and build the dashboards leaders rely on to make decisions. This is a role for someone who thinks in business outcomes first and uses data and tools as the means to get there.

What you’ll do

 - Own pipeline management processes, including stage definitions, forecasting cadence, and hygiene standards, and work with sales managers to keep the pipeline accurate.

 - Build and maintain regular sales reporting covering bookings, pipeline coverage, conversion rates, win/loss, and rep and team performance.

 - Design, build, and maintain dashboards that give leadership and frontline managers a clear view of performance against targets.

 - Act as a business partner to sales leaders: understand their priorities, translate them into operational requirements, and bring data-backed recommendations to planning and business reviews.

 - Support forecasting and quarterly business reviews by preparing the data, challenging assumptions, and flagging risks early.

 - Own day-to-day administration and configuration of the CRM (e.g. Salesforce or HubSpot), including fields, workflows, user access, and reporting structure, in partnership with the RevOps or systems team.

 - Drive adoption of CRM and sales processes by working with managers and reps, and by making the right behaviour the easy one.

 - Support territory, quota, and compensation-related analysis as needed, in partnership with Finance.

 - Identify process gaps and inefficiencies across the sales funnel and lead improvements, documenting changes and training the team on them.

 - Work cross-functionally with Marketing, Finance, Customer Success, and Product Ops to keep data consistent across systems.

What you’ll bring

 - 7+ years of experience in sales operations, revenue operations, GTM operations, or a related commercial role, ideally in a [B2B SaaS / relevant industry] environment.

 - Strong experience with CRM systems, ideally Salesforce or HubSpot, including reporting and basic administration.

 - Solid understanding of sales metrics and funnel dynamics, including pipeline coverage, conversion, forecasting accuracy, and sales cycle length.

 - Proven ability to build clear reports and dashboards in tools such as Excel/Google Sheets, Looker, Tableau, or Power BI. You don’t need to write code, but you should be comfortable working with data and spotting what matters.

 - Experience running pipeline reviews or forecast calls, or supporting leaders who do.

 - A consultative approach: you can listen to a sales leader, ask the right questions, and turn their needs into a practical solution.

 - Strong communication skills, with the ability to present findings clearly to senior stakeholders and explain trade-offs simply.

 - Good judgement and attention to detail, with the ability to balance speed and accuracy.

 - Comfortable operating in a fast-paced environment with multiple priorities.

Nice to have

 - Experience supporting a sales team through a scaling or transformation phase.

 - Familiarity with sales compensation or territory planning tools.

 - Exposure to revenue analytics or forecasting methodologies.

 - Experience with a BI tool or basic SQL, though this is not required.

What success looks like

 - Leadership trusts the pipeline and forecast numbers and uses them to make decisions.

 - Sales managers run their reviews from the dashboards you’ve built, without needing manual reports.

 - CRM data quality improves measurably over time.

 - Sales leaders see you as a partner who brings ideas, not just reports.

 - English first. Since it's our company language, please submit your application in English. You’ll be using it a lot if you join us.

 - A fair look for everyone. Our talent team reads every single application to ensure the process is fair. To keep things running smoothly, we only accept applications through our system—our support team can’t pass on calls or emails.

 - Diversity drives us. We can only reach our goals if our team reflects the world around us. That starts with you hitting apply, even if you don't tick every single box. We encourage people from all backgrounds and experiences to join us.

 Location: Pittsburgh, PA
 About the team
 SumUp’s Field Sales team is on the ground, expanding into new markets across the country and building real relationships with the small and medium-sized businesses that power local communities.

 Are you ready to lead the charge in AI-driven customer service? About Anthropic 
 Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.
 About the role 
 As an Enterprise Account Executive at Anthropic, you'll join the foundational team at the forefront of introducing our cutting-edge AI productivity API and SaaS solutions to semiconductor organisations across the Netherlands. You'll drive the adoption of safe, frontier AI by securing strategic deals with semiconductor equipment makers, chip designers and manufacturers, and the specialist suppliers around them. You'll leverage your consultative sales expertise in the semiconductor and high-tech sector to propel revenue growth while becoming a trusted partner to semiconductor stakeholders, helping them embed and deploy AI while uncovering its full range of capabilities across hardware and software engineering, R&D, manufacturing, supply chain and field service. In collaboration with GTM, Product, and Marketing teams, you'll continuously refine our value proposition, sales methodology, and market positioning to resonate with semiconductor decision-makers.
 The ideal candidate will have a passion for developing new market segments, pinpointing high-potential opportunities, and executing strategies to capture them. Navigate complex, global, engineering-led organisations to reach key decision-makers, educate them about our services, and help them succeed with Anthropic. • Navigate complex semiconductor stakeholder ecosystems including executives, engineering and R&D leadership, IT and security teams, digital transformation functions, legal and compliance, and procurement offices to build consensus

title: Senior Product Manager (US Cards)
description:
ABOUT LENDABLE

Lendable is on a mission to build the world's best technology to help people get credit and save money. We're building one of the world’s leading fintech companies and are off to a strong start:



 - One of the UK’s most exciting unicorns with a team of over 800 people

 - Among the fastest-growing tech companies in the UK

 - Profitable since 2017

 - Backed by top investors including Balderton Capital and Goldman Sachs

 - Loved by customers with the best reviews in the market (4.9 across 10,000s of reviews on Trustpilot https://uk.trustpilot.com/review/lendable.co.uk)



So far, we’ve rebuilt the Big Three consumer finance products from scratch: loans, credit cards and car finance. We get money into our customers’ hands in minutes instead of days.



We’re growing fast, and there’s a lot more to do: we’re going after the two biggest Western markets (UK and US) where trillions worth of financial products are held by big banks with dated systems and painful processes.




JOIN US IF YOU WANT TO

 1. Take ownership: you are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Lendable from day 1

 2. Work in small teams of exceptional people: Lendies are relentlessly resourceful. We challenge the status quo to solve problems and find smarter solutions

 3. Build the best technology in-house: we use new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting




ABOUT THE ROLE

You'll own customer lifecycle management for US Cards. That covers everything from a customer's first transaction through every part of their relationship with us. You'll join as we prove out the book, then take it into its next phase of growth. This suits someone who wants to shape a product while it's still being defined, not inherit a finished one.


You'll be part of a small team of data-driven problem solvers. Like most teams at Lendable, it's small relative to what it runs, so you'll own decisions and their implementation rather than handing them off. The work sits close to the proprietary AI and decisioning that lets us see people as individuals rather than credit scores. You'll be expected to use AI to build, test and analyse faster than a team our size otherwise could.



WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

 - Owning the product vision and roadmap: first to market parity, then past it, for our current and expanding target segment, driven by customer understanding and experimentation.

 - Owning the customer lifecycle from first transaction onwards, including credit line management, spend and engagement growth, balance growth, pricing and proposition management, and retention and reactivation.

 - Shaping the mobile app experience to drive activation, spend and engagement.

 - Building new credit propositions alongside the core Cards product.

 - Executing hands-on: writing and resolving tickets, prototyping, and owning implementation and design decisions. You'll use AI tools to build the scrappiest thing that answers the question rather than waiting for engineering capacity.

 - Bringing Credit, Growth, Design, Data Science and Compliance with you, and partnering closely with US Cards Managing Director.

 - Setting clear, measurable goals and judging your work by whether the numbers moved, not by what shipped. You'll champion experimentation and never ship what you can't sense-check.



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Essential

 - A track record of owning product outcomes end to end. You make tough calls under ambiguity, own them, and course-correct when the evidence turns.

 - Strong analytical instinct:

 - a feel for what the numbers should look like

 - the instinct to notice when something is off

 - the persistence to find the real driver, without taking a confident answer from a dashboard or model at face value

 - Comfort working hands-on: writing and resolving tickets, prototyping, and making implementation and design decisions yourself.

 - Real fluency with AI tools as a working part of how you build, test and analyse.

 - The ability to lead through influence across Credit, Growth, Design, Data Science and Compliance. You change your mind when presented with a good argument, and you expect others to do the same.

Nice to have

 - Experience with consumer credit lifecycle levers such as credit line management, pricing, and retention and reactivation.

 - Experience shaping mobile app journeys for activation and engagement.
   


INTERVIEW PROCESS

 1. A quick chat with someone from our Talent team to see if the role is a good match.

 2. A 15-minute cognitive assessment.

 3. An interview with the Hiring Manager, covering your experience and how you approach the work.

 4. A practical exercise or case study relevant to the role, discussed with the team you'd be working with.

 5. A set of final interviews to assess how you'd thrive within our team and organisation.




LIFE AT LENDABLE

 - Winning team: the opportunity to scale up one of the world’s most successful fintech companies

 - Flexible working: flexible approach tailored to each role. Hybrid roles require three days in-office weekly; fully remote roles include regular opportunities for in-person connection through socials and off-sites

 - Socials & connection: opportunities and events to come together, socialise, and get to know each other beyond the office walls

 - Health coverage: support for your physical and mental wellbeing, including private health cover

 - Retirement & savings: long-term financial wellbeing through retirement savings plans

 - Employee referral programme: earn a competitive bonus when you refer successful new team members

 - Office meals & snacks: enjoy a fully stocked kitchen, plus complimentary lunches prepared by in-house chefs on in-office days at select locations

 - Sustainable commuting: cycle-to-work and electric vehicle salary sacrifice schemes available in select locations

description:
ABOUT LENDABLE

Lendable is on a mission to build the world's best technology to help people get credit and save money. We're building one of the world’s leading fintech companies and are off to a strong start:



 - One of the UK’s most exciting unicorns with a team of over 800 people
