So far, we’ve rebuilt the Big Three consumer finance products from scratch: loans, credit cards and car finance. We get money into our customers’ hands in minutes instead of days.



We’re growing fast, and there’s a lot more to do: we’re going after the two biggest Western markets (UK and US) where trillions worth of financial products are held by big banks with dated systems and painful processes.




JOIN US IF YOU WANT TO

 1. Take ownership: you are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Lendable from day 1

 2. Work in small teams of exceptional people: Lendies are relentlessly resourceful. We challenge the status quo to solve problems and find smarter solutions

 3. Build the best technology in-house: we use new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting



About the role

We're building a larger, dedicated Platform team at Lendable, increasing our investment in the infrastructure that enables our products and engineering teams to scale.

We're hiring a Technical Product Manager to sit within Engineering and connect platform technology, reliability and commercial value. You'll own what we prioritise and why, giving engineers the business context they need while helping Product and leadership understand the impact and opportunities that Platform enables.

This is a hands-on technical IC role, where you'll stay close to engineering through writing code, reviewing PRs and contributing to architecture discussions.

Working closely with the Platform Engineering Manager and Tech Lead, you'll help shape the Platform roadmap, connect technical investment to measurable business outcomes, and build the foundations that allow Lendable to move faster and scale with confidence.



What you'll be doing

Own platform stability

 - Own platform stability as a primary accountability - SLA/SLO metrics, incident rates, release quality.

 - Hold release gating authority: block features from production that don't meet testing standards or introduce unacceptable regression risk.

 - Enforce CI/CD standards centrally so pods don't fragment into one-off solutions.

 - Track and report stability metrics alongside commercial outcomes - stability is the foundation that makes the rest possible.

Be commercially accountable

 - Own the business case for platform investment and answer "why are we spending six engineers on this for three months?" in terms leadership understands.

 - Track platform impact in business terms: developer velocity, incident cost, time-to-market, reliability, capacity - e.g. "CXO rollout removes a 3-second API fan-out, reducing session abandonment" or "we can now handle 20k simultaneous logins".

 - Input into headcount and investment decisions for the platform team.

Own the platform roadmap

 - Own the platform backlog, prioritised by business value and sequenced to unblock the highest-value product teams first - not driven by technical debt or engineer preference alone.

 - Make trade-offs explicit: "if we do X now, we defer Y by Z weeks - here's what that means for products depending on us".

 - Ensure every initiative has a defined success metric that non-engineers can track.

Be the stakeholder interface

 - Act as the single point of contact for Pod Leads: business requirements coming from pods and engineering/developer requirements flowing to pods; prioritise both in service of platform stability.

 - Make platform work visible to leadership - regular forums with product MDs and PMs to capture upcoming dependencies before they become blockers; represent platform work in leadership reviews; translate technical milestones into business milestones.

 - Drive cross-team collaboration and buy-in with other PMs; engage architecture in technical design.

 - Escalate when product teams make requests that would create unsustainable platform load or technical debt.

Contribute as an engineer

 - Write code, review PR's, and participate in architecture design as a core part of the role - not a side project.

 - Bring a strong technical voice to roadmap decisions without owning final architecture calls (that's Architecture and Tech Leads).



What we're looking for

Essential

 - Deep, hands-on engineering background - this role must be staffed by someone who has shipped production systems, not someone who has only managed backlogs.

 - Strong commercial instinct: can build a business case, speak to P&L impact, and hold a line on ROI.

 - Exceptional stakeholder management across product, engineering, and finance without direct line authority over all of them.

 - Comfortable with ambiguity - platform value is often indirect and long-horizon.

 - Track record of contributing as an IC while operating at a senior, cross-team level.

 - Proactive, low-ego, and clear communicator - able to hold a line with leadership and pod leads alike.

Nice to have

 - Experience in platform, infrastructure, or developer tooling contexts.

 - Familiarity with SLA/SLO frameworks and incident management at scale.

 - Experience enforcing CI/CD standards across multiple teams or pods.

 - Prior work making "invisible" infrastructure legible to non-technical leadership.



Our tech stack

Platform & backend: Kotlin, AWS, Postgres, RabbitMQ, Docker, Kubernetes.

Gateway & clients: Node GraphQL gateway, React Native / TypeScript mobile app, Relay

title: Financial Crime Specialist - Transaction Monitoring
description:
Our Story
Hello there. We’re Zopa.
We started our journey back in 2005, building the first ever peer-to-peer lending company. Fast forward to 2020 and we launched Zopa Bank. A bank that listens to what our customers don’t like about finance and does the opposite. We’re redefining what it feels like to work in finance. Our vision for a new era of banking puts people front and centre — we’ve built a business that empowers everyone to aim high, every day, to move finance forward. Find out more about our fantastic offerings at Zopa.com! 
We’re incredibly proud of our achievements and none of it would be possible without the amazing team here. It’s not just industry awards we’re winning, we’ve also been named in the top three UK’s Most Loved Workplaces. 
If you embrace unconventional challenges, are unafraid to think differently and are driven to make an outsized impact, you’ll thrive here at Zopa, so join us, and make it count. Want to see us in action? Follow us on Instagram @zopalife
The role:
As a Financial Crime Specialist, you will protect Zopa and its customers by investigating complex transaction monitoring activity, making clear and well-evidenced decisions, and escalating suspicion appropriately. You will apply sound judgement where automation is not appropriate, ensuring our controls remain effective, proportionate and customer-focused. 
This role is central to how we’re evolving financial crime at Zopa. You’ll combine investigative expertise with the assurance of AI-enabled tools, challenging AI outputs, identifying control gaps and helping improve the quality and consistency of decisions across Financial Crime Operations.
Working pattern:
This is a hybrid role, with 1 day per week in the office. You’ll work 7.5-hour shifts between 8am and 8pm, Monday to Friday.
You’ll also work one full weekend every four weeks, working remotely from 9am to 5:30pm, with weekdays off in lieu.
Some bank holiday working will also be required throughout the year, with time off in lieu provided for any bank holidays worked.

Investigate and make risk-based decisions
• Review and investigate Transaction Monitoring alerts across Zopa products, identifying activity linked to money laundering, fraud, terrorist financing and other relevant financial crime typologies.
• Take ownership of complex cases from investigation through to decision, using contextual analysis, linked-account insights and appropriate risk mitigation.
• Make timely, proportionate and well-evidenced decisions, including account restrictions and escalations where required.
• Escalate suspicious activity in line with internal procedures and relevant legal and regulatory obligations.
 Assure AI and strengthen our controls
• Use AI-enabled monitoring tools in your day-to-day casework, critically assessing alerts, summaries and recommendations rather than accepting outputs at face value.
• Assess whether AI-led decisions and customer journeys are delivering the right financial crime and customer outcomes, identifying and escalating quality, risk or control concerns.
• Share insights from investigations to help improve monitoring rules, AI performance, customer questioning and operational controls.
 Deliver strong customer and operational outcomes
• Maintain clear, accurate investigation records and rationales, documenting the evidence considered, decisions made and risks mitigated.
• Handle inbound and outbound telephone and chat conversations with professionalism and empathy, including conversations with customers whose accounts have been suspended.
• Collaborate across Financial Crime, Fraud, Customer Support, Product and Risk to progress investigations, resolve issues and improve customer outcomes.
• Proven experience investigating complex Transaction Monitoring and/or mule activity cases end to end, including making alert decisions and escalating suspicious activity where appropriate.
• A strong interest in technology-led environments, with an understanding of how AI can support day-to-day decision-making and improve outcomes.
• A sound understanding of UK financial crime requirements, including POCA, the Money Laundering Regulations and FCA expectations.
• Strong analytical judgement, with the ability to interpret complex information, identify relevant risks and produce clear, evidence-based rationales.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to handle sensitive customer conversations with care and professionalism.

If you're ambitious, collaborative, and excited by the opportunity to create meaningful change, we'd love to hear from you.Join us and help shape the future.Ocean Infinity is seeking a highly motivated and experienced New Build Project Manager to lead critical projects within our Robotics Asset Delivery Department. The ideal candidate will have a strong track record of delivering new build projects to time, budget, and scope, with a keen understanding of managing dependencies within a broader programme context. This role requires excellent organisational skills, a proactive approach to problem-solving, and the ability to collaborate effectively with diverse, distributed teams and stakeholders.What you will do:Project Planning & Execution:Plan, execute, and close projects within assigned programmes, adhering to established methodologies and Transformation Office governance frameworks. Develop detailed project plans, including scope definition, dependencies, resource allocation, and realistic timelines. Define and manage project budgets, track expenditure, and ensure projects are delivered within financial constraints. Monitor project progress, identify deviations from the plan, and implement corrective actions as needed. Champion the adoption of technology and AI to aid delivery, introducing efficiencies and use to add control to day-to-day delivery. Stakeholder Management:Build and maintain strong working relationships with project stakeholders, including internal teams, vendors, and external partners. Communicate project status, risks, and issues effectively to the Programme Manager and relevant stakeholders. Facilitate workshops and meetings to drive project progress and resolve issues. Risk & Issue Management: Proactively identify, assess, and manage project-level risks and issues, developing mitigation strategies. Escalate critical issues to the Programme Manager in a timely manner, providing clear recommendations for resolution alongside other options considered. Quality & Change Management:Ensure project deliverables meet defined quality standards and stakeholder expectations. Manage project change requests, assessing their impact on scope, schedule, and budget, and securing necessary approvals. Reporting & Documentation:Prepare and submit regular project reports, providing accurate and timely updates on progress, budget, and risks. Maintain comprehensive project documentation, including project plans, meeting minutes, and decision logs. Ensure project closure activities are completed efficiently, including lessons learned and handover of deliverables. BenefitsSalary for this position: Up to £75,000 per annum

Drive innovation and digital design, supporting the move towards fully attributed 3D and BIM-enabled models. Champion sustainable design by embedding low-carbon thinking, nature-based solutions, and whole-life value considerations. Engage with suppliers, partners, and stakeholders to review and integrate third-party design inputs effectively. Ensure all design work meets CDM and health & safety requirements, producing high-quality outputs that meet end-user and operational needs. Strong design management experience, ideally within the water or environmental infrastructure sectors. Proven ability to lead multidisciplinary engineering teams to deliver high-quality, sustainable design outcomes. Technical understanding of clean water or water recycling systems, pipelines, or treatment processes. Experience of working within a design and build or collaborative project delivery environment. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, able to translate complex technical information clearly. National Infrastructure Portfolio - PDM to work alongside some of the major infrastructure projects (rail / highways / energy) in the region focusing on protecting and diverting all the affected Anglian Water assets (potable and wastewater). New customers: You will engage with day-1 customers as the advocate to ensure that project planning, kick-off, requirements documentation, implementation, and go-live remain on track. Although not responsible for the delivery of those actions, you will ensure that the cross-functional teams who are responsible are tracking, and alert leadership to potential risks or delays. title: Senior Product Regulatory, Privacy, & AI Compliance Program Manager Confluent
description: IntroductionIBM’s Trust and Security Confluent organization is pioneering a fundamentally new category of data infrastructure focused on data in motion. Have you ever found a new favorite series on Netflix, picked up groceries curbside at Walmart, or paid for something using Square? That's the power of data in motion in action — giving organizations instant access to the massive amounts of data that is constantly flowing throughout their business. At IBM , we're building the foundational platform for this new paradigm of data infrastructure.The Office of the CISO (OCISO) is part of IBM's Trust and Security Confluent organization. Its mission is to earn and retain trust by championing Confluent's security, privacy, resilience, and compliance positions, thereby accelerating customer adoption and use of our platform and products.OCISO is building a Global Product Regulatory Compliance team: a new function that determines which laws, regulations, and industry frameworks apply to Confluent's products, translates them into product and platform controls, and gives customers, regulators, and our field teams clear and consistent answers. The program covers direct obligations, such as the EU GDPR, Digital Operational Resilience Act (DORA), EU Cyber Resilience Act (CRA), and indirect obligations that flow down from customers in financial services, healthcare, the public sector, telecommunications, and other regulated industries. Coverage spans cybersecurity, operational resilience, privacy, sovereignty, AI governance, and third-party risk management.Your Role And ResponsibilitiesAs Senior Product Regulatory, Privacy, & AI Compliance Program Manager you will operate on a global scale, so you will develop relationships with OCISO team members in the Americas, EMEA, and APAC, and partner closely with IBM's Regulatory Compliance, Legal, and Government & Regulatory Affairs teams. Organizational, interpersonal and communication skills are key to success.We are looking for a motivated, high energy senior individual contributor who can own and successfully execute with minimal oversight. This is a senior role with real influence and accountability. The right person is able to manage multiple deliverables simultaneously, enjoys doing in-depth regulatory research and analysis, and hands on work, executing deliverables personally, rather than coordinating others. The successful candidate will thrive in ambiguity, is adept at context switching, and comfortable with fluid execution priorities. Heavy AI usage is expected.Regulatory Compliance ResponsibilitiesHorizon Scanning — Monitor new and revised regulatory rules. Triage developments and draft regulatory watch briefs. Establish an intake mechanism to automate horizon scanning leveraging AI capabilities.Regulatory Analysis — Review regulatory texts, supervisory guidance, and industry frameworks and best practices. Determine the impact to Confluent's products, and produce clear applicability and impact assessments that state what applies, why, and what it requires of the product. Serve as the subject matter expert on key global regulatory requirements.Regulatory Resource Library & Control Mapping — Maintain and build out the program's golden-source inventory of regulations and frameworks. Map requirements to Confluent's control framework and IBM's enterprise baseline controls, and keep mappings accurate and version-controlled.Control Posture Assessments — Conduct risk-based posture assessments against priority obligations such as EU DORA and the EU Cyber Resilience Act. Document findings and propose control enhancements or feature build outs to Product or Engineering owners for inclusion in their roadmaps. Regulated Industry & Field Support — Support OCISO customer-facing leads on flow-down obligations from financial services, public sector, and healthcare customers, under frameworks such as SEC Reg SCI, FFIEC, HIPAA, FedRAMP, DORA, NIS2, GDPR, EU AI Act, and the EU Cyber Resilience Act. Turn recurring customer questions into standard, reusable positions.Audits, Examinations & Incident Notifications — Prepare evidence, documentation, and technical responses for regulatory audits and examinations touching Confluent products (for example, under DORA), coordinated through IBM.Advisory & Enablement Content — Craft field enablement materials, such as advisory notes for Product regulatory and Engineering, executive summaries, control mappings, FAQs, customer guides, presentations, and training. Contribute to the development of Trust Center content, including white papers and blogs on regulatory trends. Partner with Government & Regulatory Affairs to influence emerging regulations and policies, as needed.Privacy Compliance ResponsibilitiesPrivacy compliance program - Operationalize a global privacy compliance program from the ground up. Support new privacy and sovereignty rule implementation, maintain a global rule inventory, map privacy obligations across applicable regimes to documented controls, and complete product PIAs, DPIAs, and IBM’s information governance processes.Global Privacy SME - Serve as a global privacy expert, providing advisory guidance on privacy rules and regulations, responding to Product questions and assessing new product launches through a privacy control lens. Customer notifications - Manage customer cyber incident response notifications in partnership with IBM enterprise teams. Privacy certifications - Complete and maintain certifications such as the Data Privacy Framework and ISO/IEC 27701.Advisory & Enablement Content — Craft field enablement materials, such as advisory notes for Product regulatory and Engineering, executive summaries, control mappings, FAQs, customer guides, presentations, and training. Contribute to the development of Trust Center content, including white papers and blogs on regulatory trends. Partner with Government & Regulatory Affairs to influence emerging regulations and policies, as needed.Preferred EducationMaster

title: Salesforce Manager
description:
About The RoleWe're looking for a Salesforce Manager to take ownership of our Salesforce ecosystem and lead the continued evolution of one of our most business-critical platforms. Reporting to the Head of Group IT, you'll be responsible for the strategic direction, performance, security and ongoing development of our Salesforce environment, while leading a team of seven Salesforce professionals.A key focus of the role will be driving our platform simplification strategy, reducing technical debt and moving away from complex custom APEX development towards scalable, low-code Salesforce solutions using Flow and other declarative capabilities. You'll play a central role in shaping the Salesforce roadmap, partnering with business stakeholders, architects and technology leaders to ensure the platform continues to support our customers and colleagues effectively.This is a leadership role combining platform ownership, people management, stakeholder engagement and technical decision-making. You'll oversee platform health, release management, integrations, security, vendor relationships and the adoption of Salesforce AI capabilities where they can deliver genuine business value.As part of our smart working approach, this role requires weekly attendance at our Andover, Hampshire office, so you'll need to be within a reasonable commuting distance and comfortable travelling to the office on a regular basis.About YouYou'll be an experienced Salesforce leader who has owned and managed a Salesforce org within a complex enterprise environment. You'll bring a strong blend of technical expertise, strategic thinking and people leadership, with the confidence to influence stakeholders at all levels of the organisation.We're Particularly Interested In Candidates Who HaveExperience owning and managing a Salesforce platform, including governance, release management and service performance.A strong background in Salesforce Flow and low-code solutions, with experience simplifying and modernising Salesforce environments.Working knowledge of APEX, enabling you to assess, challenge and refactor existing custom development where appropriate.Experience leading technical teams and developing capability within Salesforce functions.Knowledge of Salesforce DevOps, integrations, security models and platform best practice.Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to translate business requirements into practical technical solutions.Salesforce certifications such as Administrator, Advanced Administrator, Platform App Builder or Platform Developer I. Architect certifications would be advantageous.Above all, you'll be someone who enjoys simplifying complexity, driving continuous improvement and helping teams deliver better outcomes through technologyYour Recruitment JourneyOur recruitment process has been designed to help us get to know you, your experience and your leadership approach, while giving you the opportunity to learn more about Simplyhealth and the impact this role can have.Your Journey Is Likely To IncludeAn initial conversation with our Talent Acquisition team.A first-stage interview focused on your Salesforce platform leadership experience, stakeholder management and approach to simplification and transformation.A final-stage interview, which may include a presentation or technical discussion centred on Salesforce strategy, platform governance and team leadership.We'll keep you updated throughout the process and provide feedback wherever possible, ensuring you have a positive and transparent experience from application to offer.ApplyShare Facebook X LinkedIn WhatsAppEmail

title: Transformation Project Manager
description:
Job summary
Turn transformation plans into action
We are looking for a proactive and experienced 
Band 7 Transformation Project Manager
 to join our Transformation Team in a new role created to strengthen our delivery capacity.
You will lead the end-to-end delivery of multiple transformation and improvement projects and workstreams, working alongside clinical, operational and corporate teams to turn agreed priorities into practical, sustainable change.
This is a hands-on delivery role. You will drive progress, maintain momentum, constructively challenge where delivery is slipping and ensure clear ownership of milestones, actions, risks and benefits.
The role will support service redesign, productivity, efficiency and Cost Improvement Programme (CIP) delivery, with a focus on achieving measurable improvements for patients, services and the organisation.
Regular onsite presence will be essential, enabling you to work directly with teams, understand operational challenges and actively support delivery.
Main duties of the job
What you will be doing
You will:
Lead assigned projects and workstreams from initiation through to implementation and benefits realisation.
Develop and maintain clear project plans, milestones, risks, dependencies and delivery controls.
Drive progress and maintain momentum, identifying barriers, following through actions and escalating issues where needed.
Work alongside clinical and operational teams to redesign services and improve pathways, productivity and performance.
Support the delivery of transformation, efficiency and CIP schemes, ensuring projects have clear, measurable outcomes.
Use operational, financial, clinical and benchmarking information to identify opportunities and monitor impact.
Build strong relationships across services, bringing the right people together to turn plans into action.
Facilitate workshops and improvement activity, providing constructive challenge and practical delivery support.
Provide clear governance, reporting and escalation, ensuring progress, risks and benefits remain visible.
We are looking for someone who enjoys being close to delivery, creates structure in a complex environment and takes ownership for moving projects forward.
About us
Croydon Health Services NHS Trust provide hospital and community services from a number of community and specialist clinics throughout Croydon.
These include:o Croydon University Hospitalo Purley Hospitalo The Sickle Cell and Thalassaemia Centre in Thornton Heatho Community bases at Purley, Sanderstead, New Addington, Broad Green, Woodsideo A minor injuries unit in New AddingtonThe Trust was formed on 1st August 2010 through the integration of Croydon Community Health Services and Mayday Healthcare NHS Trust. Around 3,500 staff provide services for a population of over 360,000 people who are relatively young with a high level of ethnic diversity.Our Vision:"Excellent integrated care for you and your family, when and where you need it"Our 5 key 'Here for you' promises to the people of Croydon are:o You feel cared for by helpful and welcoming staffo You feel in safe hands with highly professional staffo You feel confident in your treatment from skilled teams of compassionate clinicianso You feel we value your time with convenient appointments, minimal waiting and care closer to homeo You feel it's getting better all the time as we continue to improve our services
We are one of 17 Trusts in the country who have been accepted as national pioneers on staff engagement and empowerment, through the adoption of "Listening into Action" as a new way of working. The approach we are taking to "Listening into Action" is new and different.

description:
Ebury helps ambitious businesses unlock global growth, and we take the same approach with our people. We encourage innovation and movement, collaboration and problem-solving, and foster an environment where everyone can feel they belong, are valued, supported and empowered to succeed.
 If you’re a collaborator who wants to help transform how businesses operate globally, get in touch - we’d love to discuss how Ebury can accelerate your career so you can shape the future.
 Key Account Director - Defence 
 London Victoria - Onsite 
 Ebury is a global FinTech powerhouse. We don’t just move money; we empower international businesses to trade without boundaries. With a suite of products ranging from complex FX risk management and supplier payment financing to integrated API solutions, we are the strategic engine behind some of the world’s most ambitious firms.
 The Role 
 As a Key Account Director for Defence, you will lead the charge in this high-stakes vertical, navigating C-suite relationships to deliver sophisticated treasury and hedging solutions. The Defence industry operates on long-term cycles, massive capital outlays, and intricate global supply chains and your approach should reflect this. You aren't just hitting targets—you are a role model on our London floor, mentoring the next generation of talent and setting the gold standard for how Ebury dominates the market. 
 Responsibilities: 
• Strategic Origination: Identify and onboard Tier-1 prospects within the Defence and Aerospace sectors.
• Solution Architecting: Move beyond "spot trades." You will sell complex FX hedging strategies, cash management, and supplier payment financing solutions tailored to long-cycle defense contracts.
• C-Suite Navigation: Build and leverage high-level relationships with CFOs, Treasurers, and Finance Directors, understanding their specific budgeting and risk appetite.
• Sector Advocacy: Act as the internal "Defence Expert," providing feedback to Product teams to ensure Ebury’s roadmap remains the best-in-class for this sector.
• Excellence in Execution: Maintain a rigorous pipeline via Salesforce, ensuring a culture of data-driven sales and superior relationship management.
 Why Ebury? 
• Market-Leading Rewards: A competitive base salary with a transparent, uncapped commission structure designed for high-achievers.
• Next-Gen Tech: Access to an advanced product suite, including our proprietary API integrations and multi-currency platforms.
• Global Mobility: Opportunities for international bootcamps and visiting one of our global offices.
• Fast-Track Leadership: A clear growth pathway from individual contributor to a partner in the business.
• Work from our flagship, modern office in London Victoria.
 You... 
• Understand Defense: You can speak the language of "fixed-price bids," "long-term procurement," and "sovereign risk."
• Are a Master Negotiator: You thrive in high-value negotiations and can articulate complex financial concepts to diverse stakeholders.
• Are a Culture Carrier: You lead by example, fostering a competitive yet collaborative environment on the sales floor.
• Speak Fluent English (a second language is a bonus).
 Feel free to reach out directly on LinkedIn - Freddie Mugridge
 #LI-DNP
 About us 
 Ebury delivers sophisticated, integrated solutions — business accounts, hedging, and financing — on a single platform with a seamless workflow. Our success is built on a simple premise and singular purpose: To help businesses operate and scale globally. 
 Since its founding in 2009, Ebury has always been a fast-growing leader in fintech. Today, we bring together 2000+ Eburians across nearly 70 cities and we’re always looking to add to our team. 
 At the heart of our offering is a proprietary platform, purpose-built to help businesses seamlessly streamline and manage global cash flow. We focus on continuous product evolution and innovation to build the infrastructure for borderless growth and help our clients scale at every stage. 
 The opportunities at Ebury are as diverse as our people, ranging from business development to engineering roles across our tech pillars.
 We believe in inclusion. We stand against discrimination in all forms and are against the intolerance of differences that makes us a modern and successful organisation. At Ebury, you can be whoever you want to be and still feel a sense of belonging no matter your story.
 Important Security Notice for Job Applicants:
 Ebury only accepts applications via official Ebury channels. We will only contact you from an @ ebury.com domain. Always check the emails you receive from us, and note that we will never request payment for any part of the recruitment process. Stay safe and report suspicious activity.
 Notice to Recruitment Agencies and Search Firms:
 Ebury does not accept unsolicited resumes, CVs, or candidate profiles from recruitment agencies or search firms without signed written Ebury recruitment terms in place for a specific role. Any unsolicited applications will be considered the sole property of Ebury. Ebury will not be responsible or liable for any placement fees or costs associated with unagreed candidate submissions or subsequent hires.

 Ebury uses Artificial Intelligence (AI) and automated tools to help streamline certain parts of our recruitment process, however, these tools are strictly for administrative efficiency. All hiring decisions, including application reviews, shortlisting, and final selections are evaluated and conducted by human talent acquisition professionals and hiring managers.

title: Sales Lead - Defence
description:
Ebury helps ambitious businesses unlock global growth, and we take the same approach with our people. We encourage innovation and movement, collaboration and problem-solving, and foster an environment where everyone can feel they belong, are valued, supported and empowered to succeed.
 If you’re a collaborator who wants to help transform how businesses operate globally, get in touch - we’d love to discuss how Ebury can accelerate your career so you can shape the future.
 Sales Lead - Defence 
 London Victoria - Onsite 
 Ebury is a global FinTech powerhouse. We don’t just move money; we empower international businesses to trade without boundaries. With a suite of products ranging from complex FX risk management and supplier payment financing to integrated API solutions, we are the strategic engine behind some of the world’s most ambitious firms.
 The Role 
 As the Sales Lead for Defence, you will lead the charge in this high-stakes vertical, navigating C-suite relationships to deliver sophisticated treasury and hedging solutions. The Defence industry operates on long-term cycles, massive capital outlays, and intricate global supply chains and your approach should reflect this. You aren't just hitting targets—you are a role model on our London floor, mentoring the next generation of talent and setting the gold standard for how Ebury dominates the market. 
 Responsibilities: 
• Strategic Origination: Identify and onboard Tier-1 prospects within the Defence and Aerospace sectors.
• Solution Architecting: Move beyond "spot trades." You will sell complex FX hedging strategies, cash management, and supplier payment financing solutions tailored to long-cycle defense contracts.
• C-Suite Navigation: Build and leverage high-level relationships with CFOs, Treasurers, and Finance Directors, understanding their specific budgeting and risk appetite.
• Sector Advocacy: Act as the internal "Defence Expert," providing feedback to Product teams to ensure Ebury’s roadmap remains the best-in-class for this sector.
• Excellence in Execution: Maintain a rigorous pipeline via Salesforce, ensuring a culture of data-driven sales and superior relationship management.
 Why Ebury? 
• Market-Leading Rewards: A competitive base salary with a transparent, uncapped commission structure designed for high-achievers.
• Next-Gen Tech: Access to an advanced product suite, including our proprietary API integrations and multi-currency platforms.
• Global Mobility: Opportunities for international bootcamps and visiting one of our global offices.
• Fast-Track Leadership: A clear growth pathway from individual contributor to a partner in the business.
• Work from our flagship, modern office in London Victoria.
 You... 
• Understand Defense: You can speak the language of "fixed-price bids," "long-term procurement," and "sovereign risk."
• Are a Master Negotiator: You thrive in high-value negotiations and can articulate complex financial concepts to diverse stakeholders.
• Are a Culture Carrier: You lead by example, fostering a competitive yet collaborative environment on the sales floor.
• Speak Fluent English (a second language is a bonus).
 Feel free to reach out directly on LinkedIn - Freddie Mugridge
 #LI-FM2
 #LI-ONSITE
 About us 
 Ebury delivers sophisticated, integrated solutions — business accounts, hedging, and financing — on a single platform with a seamless workflow. Our success is built on a simple premise and singular purpose: To help businesses operate and scale globally. 
 Since its founding in 2009, Ebury has always been a fast-growing leader in fintech. Today, we bring together 2000+ Eburians across nearly 70 cities and we’re always looking to add to our team. 
 At the heart of our offering is a proprietary platform, purpose-built to help businesses seamlessly streamline and manage global cash flow. We focus on continuous product evolution and innovation to build the infrastructure for borderless growth and help our clients scale at every stage. 
 The opportunities at Ebury are as diverse as our people, ranging from business development to engineering roles across our tech pillars.
 We believe in inclusion. We stand against discrimination in all forms and are against the intolerance of differences that makes us a modern and successful organisation. At Ebury, you can be whoever you want to be and still feel a sense of belonging no matter your story.
 Important Security Notice for Job Applicants:
 Ebury only accepts applications via official Ebury channels. We will only contact you from an @ ebury.com domain. Always check the emails you receive from us, and note that we will never request payment for any part of the recruitment process. Stay safe and report suspicious activity.
 Notice to Recruitment Agencies and Search Firms:
 Ebury does not accept unsolicited resumes, CVs, or candidate profiles from recruitment agencies or search firms without signed written Ebury recruitment terms in place for a specific role. Any unsolicited applications will be considered the sole property of Ebury. Ebury will not be responsible or liable for any placement fees or costs associated with unagreed candidate submissions or subsequent hires.
 AI Transparency Statement:
 Ebury uses Artificial Intelligence (AI) and automated tools to help streamline certain parts of our recruitment process, however, these tools are strictly for administrative efficiency. All hiring decisions, including application reviews, shortlisting, and final selections are evaluated and conducted by human talent acquisition professionals and hiring managers.

title: Account Executive, Quantitative Trading & Investing
description:
About Anthropic 
 Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.
 About the role 
 As a Strategic Account Executive for quantitative firms at Anthropic, you'll join the foundational team introducing our frontier AI platform to the world's leading quantitative hedge funds, systematic asset managers, market makers, and proprietary trading firms. You'll drive adoption of safe, frontier AI by securing strategic, enterprise-scale deals with firms whose researchers, technologists, and traders are among the most technical users in financial services. You'll draw on your experience selling to quantitative firms to grow revenue while becoming a trusted advisor to your customers, helping them embed AI into quantitative research, software engineering, data, risk, and operations workflows, and uncovering its full range of capabilities. Working closely with Product and Marketing, you'll continuously sharpen our value proposition, sales motion, and market positioning for quantitative firms.
 This role suits someone energised by building a new category with customers who test every claim, often build their own technology, and set a high bar for performance, security, and protection of their intellectual property. You'll identify high-potential accounts and run the strategies to win and grow them. By driving deployment of Anthropic's emerging products in quantitative firms, you'll help these organisations unlock new capabilities while advancing the responsible development of AI.
 Key responsibilities

title: Enablement Lead, Government
description:
About the Team

The Adoption, Innovation, and Transformation team within OpenAI for Government helps government organizations turn OpenAI products into durable capabilities and measurable mission impact.

We work alongside public servants to move from initial exploration to confident, responsible, organization-wide use of AI. Our work combines hands-on enablement, adoption strategy, deployment support, community, content, and practical transformation tailored to government missions and operating environments.

By translating the potential of OpenAI’s technology into better individual workflows, stronger teams, and improved public services, we help government customers deepen adoption, build lasting organizational capability, and spend more time on mission.

About the Role

The Enablement Lead, Government is a specialist role focused on delivering high-impact enablement and adoption services across OpenAI’s product suite. This role is responsible for designing and delivering experiences that support repeatable adoption frameworks, drive sustained activation, expand the breadth and depth of usage, and produce measurable value for government organizations.

This role sits at the intersection of enablement, education, adoption, community, content, and customer experience. It blends strong product fluency, instructional design, customer advisory, and a deep understanding of public service. You will lead live workshops, deliver enablement programs, and design adoption interventions for audiences ranging from front-line public servants and technical practitioners to senior government leaders.

You will be a trusted guide to government customers, helping them learn, share, teach, celebrate successes, and use AI confidently in their day-to-day work. You will help organizations understand not only what OpenAI’s products can do, but how to apply them safely and effectively while respecting their missions, operating environments, workforce needs, and responsibilities to the public.

Success in this role means accelerating customer confidence, increasing product adoption, supporting successful launches and deployments, and helping government organizations translate product capabilities into tangible mission outcomes. You will own outcomes related to activation and sustained usage while helping shape how OpenAI enables and supports public-sector customers at scale.

title: Capital Projects: Programme Manager
description:
Job summary
Capital Projects: Programme Manager - Band 8c
We are seeking an experienced Programme Manager to oversee the work of the strategic capital programme at Croydon Health Services NHS Trust. Likely projects include a New Endoscopy Unit, a Pharmacy Refurbishment and the development of a new Maternity Unit.
Reporting to the Deputy Director of Strategy and Capital Programmes
Main duties of the job
The post holder will:
Manage a portfolio of complex strategic estates projects, maintaining oversight of scope, programme, cost, quality, risk, dependencies, resources, governance and benefits.
Identify opportunities for estate rationalisation, investment, acquisition, disposal, redevelopment and partnership working.
Commission and manage external consultants, professional advisers and contractors, ensuring effective performance, appropriate use of resources and compliance with procurement requirements and Standing Financial Instructions.
Coordinate the preparation of strategic outline cases, business cases, funding submissions, board papers and approval documentation in accordance with NHS requirements and Trust governance.
Provisional Interview Date 14th & 15th December 2026
About us
Croydon Health Services NHS Trust provides hospital and community services across Croydon through a range of clinics and specialist centres. Formed in August 2010 from the integration of Croydon Community Health Services and Mayday Healthcare NHS Trust, we employ around 4,100 staff serving a diverse population of over 360,000 people.
Our main site, Croydon University Hospital, is one of the busiest in London. We are also leading the way in delivering more healthcare in community settings and people's homes. Our district nursing teams, Allied Health Professionals and community matrons care for people of all ages across the borough.
Like the wider NHS, we are working hard to meet increasing demand. With the right people on board, we continue to innovate and transform our services to provide the highest quality care for local residents. We place strong emphasis on education, training and career development for all staff.
If you want to make a real difference, challenge yourself and be part of a Trust that's shaping local healthcare, Croydon Health Services could be the place for you.
At Croydon Health Services NHS Trust, we are committed to supporting flexible working arrangements. Applicants are encouraged to discuss any flexibility they may need during the recruitment process.

title: Capital Programme Health and Safety Manager
description:
Job summary
The Capital Programme Health and Safety Manager is responsible for leading and overseeing all health, safety and regulatory compliance activities associated with the UKHSA Porton Capital Programme, ensuring the safe delivery of a diverse portfolio of capital projects within a live High Hazard Life Sciences environment.
The successful candidate must meet the security requirements before they can be appointed. The level of security needed is Security Check (SC).
For meaningful National Security Vetting checks to be carried out, the successful candidate will need to have lived in the UK for a sufficient period of time. They should normally have been resident in the United Kingdom for the last 5 years as the role requires SC clearance.
Main duties of the job
Working directly with the programme team, and collaboratively with the wider Estates, Engineering and Facilities (EEF) team and scientific stakeholders at the Porton Site, the Capital Programme Health and Safety Manager will provide expert leadership, advice and assurance for a number of high-profile programmes of work at UKHSA Porton Down, a principal site in the agency's portfolio of scientific facilities.
They will develop, implement and maintain effective health and safety management systems, programme assurance arrangements and compliance frameworks, ensuring all activities are conducted in accordance with UKHSA policies, statutory requirements and industry best practice, including the Construction (Design and Management) Regulations (CDM).
Specific duties will vary, but examples of these will include:
Lead and oversee all health and safety and regulatory compliance activities associated with the UKHSA Porton Capital Programme.
Contain and control risk by enforcing health and safety procedures, maintaining compliance, and ensuring measures are in place to mitigate residual risk.
Maintain statutory compliance and satisfy health and safety requirements of regulatory bodies.
Communicate proactively and professionally with stakeholders at all levels.
Ensure the department is audit ready for both internal and external audits.
The above is not an exhaustive list.
About us
We pride ourselves as being an employer of choice, where Everyone Matters promoting equality of opportunity to actively encourage applications from everyone, including groups currently underrepresented in our workforce.
UKHSA ethos is to be an inclusive organisation for all our staff and stakeholders. To create, nurture and sustain an inclusive culture, where differences drive innovative solutions to meet the needs of our workforce and wider communities. We do this through celebrating and protecting differences by removing barriers and promoting equity and equality of opportunity for all.

description:
Job summary
This is an exciting opportunity to play an active role within the Group's Digital Delivery Team, supporting the implementation of NHS England products and in-house informatics solutions for a wide range of stakeholders.
The Delivery Manager will play a pivotal role in overseeing the implementation of FDP digital solutions, as well as in-house developments, across all Group sites. Working closely with senior Trust stakeholders, NHS and in-house BI teams, you will help ensure that FDP's fast-paced programmes are well planned, well governed, and delivered effectively within agreed timeframes.
Main duties of the job
Identify interdependencies across projects/functions, potential impacts on wider organisation, resource requirements and building in contingency and adjustments as necessary.
Determine the key metrics/ benefits to which any tools are measured by and ensure they are in line with the stakeholders understanding of each tool.
About us
Ashford and St. Peters Hospitals NHS Foundation Trust is the largest provider of acute hospital services to Surrey residents, serving a population of 410,00 people and employing approximately 4,800 staff.
Our vision is to provide an outstanding experience and best outcomes for patients and the team. We are committed to providing continuous professional development and flexibility to deliver our workforce plan.
We work in partnership with Royal Surrey Hospital NHS Foundation Trust through a collaborative Group Model, supporting joined-up services, workforce flexibility and development opportunities.
St Peter's Hospital delivers complex medical and surgical care, maternity and emergency services. Day and Orthopaedic Surgery, Ophthalmology and Outpatient services are delivered at Ashford Hospital. Additional services are delivered at Woking Community Hospital.
Our Values provide us with the behaviours we respect and can commit to. By living our values through our everyday interactions, we can build a stronger, more resilient, and forward- thinking organisation, guiding us to achieve success and make a positive impact on how we deliver our services.
We can offer you the full range of NHS benefits & discounts.

title: Implementations Manager
description:
Role: Implementation ManagerLocation: London (Hybrid)Employment: FulltimeRole PurposeWe are looking for an experienced Implementation and Cut-Over Manager to lead the end-to-end deployment, data migration and cut-over strategy for a major public sector digital transformation programme.In this pivotal role, you will orchestrate the complex transition from a legacy Oracle core system to a modern Microsoft Dynamics 365 (D365) application suite, featuring a hybrid database architecture split across Azure Cosmos DB and Microsoft Dataverse. You will also coordinate the simultaneous re-platforming and integration of multiple Scala-based GDS (Government Digital Service) front-end channels, a brand-new integration layer, and downstream analytics and legislative reporting feeds.Your leadership will ensure seamless citizen-facing service continuity, zero critical data loss, full compliance with government legislative mandates, and alignment with the GDS Service Standard.Key Responsibilities Cut-Over Strategy & Master Planning Design, govern and execute the comprehensive Master Cut-Over Plan (MCP), encompassing minute-by-minute deployment schedules, blackout windows, go/no-go criteria and fallback procedures. Ensure all cut-over phases and readiness gates satisfy strict public sector audit requirements and align with the GDS Service Standard (supporting Alpha, Beta and Live transitions). Coordinate synchronised cut-over activities across multi-disciplinary squads, legacy system custodians, commercial vendors and external suppliers. Hybrid Data Migration & Dual-Store Governance Oversee the end-to-end data migration strategy, ensuring clean extraction, transformation and loading (ETL) from legacy Oracle to a split-persistence model: Microsoft Dataverse for relational business data and Azure Cosmos DB for high-throughput, scale-out storage. Establish robust data reconciliation frameworks, automated validation routines and audit trails to guarantee referential integrity and zero data loss. Plan and direct rigorous migration dry runs (Mock 1, Mock 2, Final Dress Rehearsal) to validate performance, pipeline throughput and execution timing within strict implementation windows. Multi-Channel Replatforming & Integration Orchestration Manage the simultaneous cut-over and re-routing of multiple Scala-based GDS public-facing channels, ensuring zero disruption to citizen interactions and maintaining strict API contracts. Supervise the deployment and priming of the new integration middleware tier (e.g. Azure Integration Services, API gateways, message queues) connecting front-end channels to the D365 core. Coordinate the cut-over of downstream data ingestion pipelines, data warehouses, and statutory and legislative government reporting feeds. Governance, Command Centre & Risk Management Lead structured Go/No-Go readiness reviews with Senior Responsible Owners (SROs), digital directors and technical leads, presenting defensible risk metrics. Establish and lead the Go-Live Command Centre (War Room) during the deployment weekend, managing real-time escalations and operational triage. Oversee the post-live hypercare stabilisation phase, tracking defect resolution and managing a smooth handover to permanent service operations.Key Requirements & Essential SkillsTechnical & Architecture Experience Senior experience as a Release, Implementation or Cut-Over Manager leading large-scale enterprise technology transformations. Deep, practical knowledge of migrations involving Microsoft Dynamics 365 and the wider Azure ecosystem, specifically Azure Cosmos DB and Microsoft Dataverse architectures. Familiarity with modern microservices, API-led connectivity and high-volume public sector digital channels (such as Scala-based GDS services). Proven track record of planning and executing complex, high-volume data migrations from legacy relational systems (e.g. Oracle).Public Sector & Compliance Competencies Extensive working knowledge of the UK Government Digital Service (GDS) Service Standard, Service Manual and Technology Code of Practice (TCoP). Experience navigating government spend controls, digital service assessments, and public sector security and data protection standards (UK GDPR, DPA 2018).Leadership & Soft Skills Exceptional crisis management: Calm, decisive and structured under intense pressure during critical go-live weekends. Outstanding stakeholder management: Equally comfortable bridging deep-dive technical engineering teams (Scala developers, D365 architects, DBAs) with non-technical policy makers, SROs and commercial suppliers. Strong risk identification and mitigation mindset: A history of building bulletproof contingency and rollback plans.

title: Senior Operations Responder
description:
A BOUT TIDE 
 At Tide, we help SMEs save time and money in the running of their businesses by not only offering business accounts and related banking services, but also a comprehensive set of highly usable and connected administrative solutions, from invoicing to accounting.
 Tide is transforming the small business banking market and now supports over 2 million members globally across the UK, Germany and France.
 Using advanced technology, all solutions are designed with SMEs in mind. With quick onboarding, low fees and innovative features, we thrive on making data driven decisions to serve our mission: to help SMEs save time and money so they can get back to doing what they love.
 Tide facts: 
• Tide is available for UK, German and French SMEs
• Over 2 million members globally and rapidly growing
• Over $300 million raised in funding
• 3,000 Tideans globally

 ABOUT THE ROLE
 The Tide Security Engineering team is made up of three core areas: Product Security, Identity, Threat Detection & Response
 Product Security consists of application and cloud security experts. Their mission is to protect the products we build, covering everything from secure design reviews to threat modelling and penetration testing, ensuring security is embedded from the ground up.
 Threat Detection & Response (this role!) focuses on protecting the company by building a robust detection and automation platform. We’re proactive in our defence, constantly hacking ourselves to improve our security posture and staying ahead of emerging threats. Our goal is to make Tide resilient against the ever-evolving threat landscape.

The team uses strategies like zero trust, multi-factor authentication, and granular role-based access controls to safeguard our internal operations.
 While each area has its own focus, collaboration is key - it's why we share the same Slack channel and hold our standups together as one cohesive team, ensuring alignment and seamless communication across all security functions.
 As a Security Operations Responder, you’ll be on the front line of defending Tide. Your primary focus is actively investigating threats through our security data lake and SOAR platform – but we don’t want anyone working the same alert by hand twice. Your goal is to make investigation effective at scale: cutting manual effort through automation, and working hand-in-hand with our Detection Engineering team to improve the true positive / false positive efficacy of what lands in the queue.
 When the security queue is empty, you’ll be building – automations, enrichment and your own detections. An open mind and a curious approach are key: every investigation is a chance to make the next one faster and sharper.
 As a Security Operations Responder, you’ll be: 
 Investigating and responding to threats (your primary focus) 
• Actively triaging and investigating security alerts and threats through our security data lake and SOAR platform, across AWS, GCP, SaaS (such as Google Workspace and Okta), internal applications and employee endpoints (Windows, macOS).
• Driving every investigation to a clear, well-evidenced outcome – establishing scope, impact and root cause, and taking containment and remediation actions quickly and confidently.
• Leading the response to complex or high-severity incidents where needed, coordinating across security, IT and engineering teams through containment, remediation and recovery.
• Documenting investigations clearly and consistently, and contributing to the runbooks and investigation standards the whole team works to.
 Scaling investigation through automation & Improving detection efficacy 
• Reducing manual investigation by building SOAR playbooks, security automations and services – from data enrichment and context gathering through to automated response, such as removing phishing emails from employee mailboxes. We want you to run with the “anything is possible” mantra.
• Spotting repetitive work in the queue and turning it into automated workflows, so the team’s time goes on the investigations that genuinely need human judgement.
• Identifying gaps in log sources, parsing and enrichment in the data lake, and working to close them so investigations have the visibility they need.
• Feeding investigation outcomes back to the Detection Engineering team – flagging noisy rules, tuning false positives and highlighting coverage gaps – to continuously improve TP/FP efficacy.
• Tracking investigation metrics (such as MTTD, MTTR, TP/FP rate and automation coverage) and using them to prioritise where to improve next.
 Building when the queue is clear 
• Writing, testing and shipping your own detections alongside Detection Engineering, following our test-driven, detections-as-code practices.
• Proactively hunting for sophisticated threats across our infrastructure, using threat intelligence and lessons from past investigations to stay ahead of attackers.
• Building or enhancing internal tools that streamline investigation, improve data visibility and increase response efficiency.
• Sharing knowledge and mentoring other members of the team, raising the bar for how we investigate and respond.
 WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

• Strong investigative instincts and log analysis skills at scale, with the ability to query a security data lake or SIEM fluently – strong knowledge of one of the following: Splunk, Scanner, Sentinel, SecOps.

title: Team Lead, Data Migration Services
description:
Retire the ERPAt Light, we’re on a mission to replace the ERP. Traditional systems are slow, painful to implement, and built for factories, not modern companies. Our Smart Financial Platform (SFP) is built for today’s global, service-based businesses, automating accounting, reporting and financial flows with speed and simplicity.In just a short time, we’ve gone from idea to powering operations for leading companies like Lovable, Legora and Keyshot. We build with our customers, ship at high velocity, and obsess over making finance software that people actually love to use.You’re joining an early-stage company defining a new software category, backed by top investors including Balderton, Atomico, Cherry Ventures, Seedcamp and Entrée Capital. Our advisory board includes the former CTO of Workday Financials, the Chief Architect of SAP S/4HANA, and SVPs from EY and Oracle. At Light, you’ll work with exceptional people, build category-defining products, and have the freedom to shape something transformative.The RoleOwn the data migration practice end to end: every customer moving to Light from Xero, QuickBooks, NetSuite, Sage or spreadsheets goes through you and your team. Lead, coach and grow a small team of migration specialists, setting priorities across a pipeline of concurrent customer migrations and keeping go-live dates on track. Run migrations hands-on when it matters: extracting legacy data, mapping charts of accounts, business partners, open invoices and balances, and reconciling the result back to the source system. Build and maintain the source-system connectors and migration flows that power our Zero Day Implementation offering, so a new customer’s records can be converted into Light in hours, not weeks. Use AI and automation to speed up mapping, cleansing and reconciliation, and turn repeated manual work into productised, self-serve tooling with Engineering and Product. Set the standards: migration methodology, mapping templates, reconciliation checks, data quality rules, and clear scope boundaries (what we migrate, what we don’t, and what’s billable, such as historical documents and attachments). Be the expert voice with customers’ finance leaders on migration questions, including multi-entity, consolidation, FX and VAT treatment, and be clear with them when a request would put accuracy or timelines at risk. Support Sales and Solutions Engineering with migration scoping, effort estimates and sample migrations for prospects. Track and report on migration throughput, time to go-live and data accuracy, and use them to decide where to automate next. How You Fit Into The TeamAs Team Lead, Data Migration Services, you sit at the front door of every Light customer relationship. Implementation Managers own the customer journey; you own getting their history into Light accurately and fast. You’ll partner daily with Implementation, Customer Success, Engineering and Sales, and report directly to the Head of Services.This is a player-coach role: you’ll lead a small team and still roll up your sleeves on the hardest migrations and connector builds. Your biggest mandate is making “zero day conversion” real: run the records first, then run the processes.Your Qualifications Could BeYou have personally delivered at least one full accounting system migration through go-live and sign-off (for example Xero, QuickBooks, Sage or NetSuite into a new platform). This is a must. Around 5 years in ERP data migration, finance systems implementation or accounting technology, including some time leading people or a workstream. Hands-on experience with at least two of Xero, QuickBooks Online, NetSuite or Sage as a source system. Strong accounting fundamentals: you understand double entry, trial balances, AR/AP subledgers, multi-entity, multi-currency and UK VAT, and can reconcile to the penny. Technical depth to build, not just configure: comfortable with REST APIs, OAuth, SQL, and scripting (Python or TypeScript) for extraction and transformation. Practical, evidenced experience using AI tools to speed up data mapping, cleansing or migration work. Experience designing repeatable ETL processes, mapping templates and data validation checks. A clear, confident communicator with finance leaders, who can explain when a request isn’t sound and suggest a better way. Able to manage many concurrent migrations while keeping quality high, with the support of a team you’ll shape. If the core of the role sounds compelling but you don’t tick every box, we’d still love for you to reach out and convince us you’re the right person. Bonus PointsA background as an accountant, auditor or finance systems consultant (ACA, ACCA, CIMA or similar). Experience building or maintaining integrations with accounting platform APIs (Xero, QBO, NetSuite SuiteTalk/SuiteQL). Exposure to IFRS, UK GAAP, consolidations, intercompany and revenue recognition. Experience at a SaaS or fintech company turning services work into product. Familiarity with workflow automation tools like n8n. The Good StuffIn addition to being part of a great team and working in a fun and innovative environment, we offer:💸 A competitive salary plus equity.🏝 A generous paid annual leave package, plus UK public holidays.🥳 Regular socials and two company offsites a year. The last 2 were in Tuscany & Provence!🚀 A huge opportunity for career growth as you help shape a market-defining product.Light is an equal opportunity employer.Final WordsWorking at Light means you’re embarking on an exciting journey to reshape the future of multinational financial operations. Our cheat code is that we’ve built something like this before, and now we’re doing it again, only better. Our goal is to make global finance effortless and empower companies to make informed decisions.If you love clean data, hate month-long implementations, and want to build the team that makes switching to Light effortless, we’d love to hear from you at careers@light.inc.Join the rocket ship while it’s taking off 🚀
